Russians have destroyed the 300 year old Holy Nativity Church in Beryslav – the only surviving example in Ukraine of 18th-century wooden Cossack religious architecture. The church was built in 1725 from oak logs, without a single metal nail. It survived wars, empires, and Soviet anti-religious campaigns. In 1784, the Cossacks transported the church across the Dnipro River from Peryvolochne to Beryslav, where it stood for over two centuries. On August 1, a Russian drone completely destroyed the shrine. This is the 337th Ukrainian church destroyed or damaged by Russia since the beginning of the full-scale invasion. The destruction of the church is yet another act of cultural genocide and a deliberate attack on Ukrainian shrines.

Decades after one of Eastern Europe’s most important synagogues was destroyed under Nazi and Soviet rule, archaeologists have uncovered the central dais, or bimah, of the Great Synagogue of Vilnius, Lithuania. Excavators were able to access the site for the first time after a Soviet-era building that stood over it was destroyed about eight months ago, excavation co-director Jon Seligman of the Israel Antiquities Authority told The Times of Israel. The synagogue, which served as the center of the city’s 60,000-strong Jewish community before the Holocaust, was ransacked by the Nazis in 1941 and then destroyed under the Soviet regime in 1957, he said. On the anniversary of the abrogation of Article 370, a Congress spokesman called the move a ‘black deed’, & demanded the restoration of statehood for Kashmir. #CutTheClutter looks at how this stand differs from that of Jawaharlal Nehru’s & returns to the fascinating Parliament debate in November 1963, when the then PM said Kashmir’s integration is complete & Article 370 is temporary. 2. In 1963, national morale was down in India after the trauma of the 1962 war with China. Nehru’s health was declining steeply. Kashmir still had a prime minister instead of a chief minister, a Sadr-e-Riyasat instead of a Governor, & its MPs were nominated by the Assembly — not directly elected. 3. This was when, Nehru — on November 27, 1963 — stood up in Parliament & said Kashmir’s special status was now wearing off. Kashmir was already fully integrated, & Article 370 was passing through a process of “gradual erosion”. Nehru also said he will not use the power of the Parliament to abrogate this, but wait for J&K assembly to make that request after which it would be done. 4. This was a politically divisive issue — sections of the opposition, particularly the Bharatiya Jana Sangh, were very keen for this special status to end immediately. But, as the Parliament debate shows, Left, Right and Centre were all committed to the same idea — that this is a temporary provision & should go. The only difference was over the pace. 5. Parliament also debated steps underway. Presidential Orders under Article 370 were steadily extending provisions of the Indian Constitution to J&K — legal & medical professions & laws relating to welfare of labour & coal mining industry. Soon after, J&K’s PM became CM & Sadr-e-Riyasat became Governor. 6. A couple of highlights from the debate: · When HV Kamath of the Praja Socialist Party interjected to say J&K was not fully integrated, Nehru replied, saying “No, I repeat that it is fully integrated. The fact that there may be some special matters attached to it does not come in the way of integration at all.” · When Congress’s PC Borooah asked if govt would seek the opinion of the people of J&K in this matter, Nehru said, normally an elected assembly is supposed to represent the people. One does not take a referendum in such a matter. 7. On one aspect, though, Nehru did support retaining safeguards. He believed restrictions on outsiders buying land in Kashmir were sensible protections, comparing them to safeguards in tribal & border regions like NEFA & parts of Assam. But he did not regard those protections as evidence that Kashmir remained outside India’s constitutional integration. He had great clarity, & it seems his legatees haven’t read his parliamentary record or his views. 8. #CutTheClutter with me. Episode 1875: Why Nehru said ‘temporary’ Article 370 is fading, will go, & how Congress stand on Kashmir differs now ￼ youtube.com/watch?v=43t8cOky…

If social media posts of Judge Hamayoun Dilawar are authentic (Tosha Khana Case Judge), this is alarming and raises serious and reasonable doubts on credibility of trial being conducted by him. In my view, propriety demands that he should immediately recuse or disassociate himself from the case. It needs to be noted that Seven Member Bench of the Supreme Court of Pakistan in Malik Qayyum Case (reported in 2001 PLD SC 568) held that bias on part of the judge vitiates judicial proceedings. The court further held that an accused has a right of a fair trial by a judicial minded person, not by someone functioning under an influence or bias as the same paralyses his judicial faculties to conduct fair trial. Bias would vitiate judicial proceedings if such circumstances exist. Bias robs the judge of the confidence that a litigant may have in the judge. Court further held that bias is mental disposition or attitude towards a particular person and covers all kind of hostilities and prejudices against him.

President Droupadi Murmu graced the 12th National Handloom Day celebrations and presented the Sant Kabir Handloom Awards and the National Handloom Awards 2025 at the Rashtrapati Bhavan Cultural Centre. The President said that handloom has been an integral part of the evolutionary journey of India’s civilization for centuries. It reflects the extraordinary diversity of our nation and has preserved our regional uniqueness. She said that by connecting India's rich handloom traditions with contemporary design, strong branding and global value chains, young entrepreneurs, designers and startups can unlock new opportunities and take Indian handloom to greater heights.

ترکیه، عربستان سعودی و پاکستان قرار است امروز (جمعه، ۱۶ اسد) یک توافق‌نامه مشترک دفاعی را در شهر جده امضا کنند؛ اقدامی که همزمان با افزایش تنش‌های منطقه‌ای و نگرانی‌ها درباره امنیت خلیج فارس انجام می‌شود. بربنیاد گزارش رویترز، رجب طیب اردوغان، رییس‌جمهور ترکیه، و شهباز شریف، نخست‌وزیر پاکستان، همراه با عاصم منیر، فرمانده‌ی ارتش پاکستان، برای امضای این توافق با محمد بن سلمان، ولیعهد عربستان سعودی، دیدار خواهند کرد. رویترز به نقل از منابع آگاه گزارش داده است که این توافق پس از نزدیک به یک سال مذاکره حاصل شده و هدف آن تقویت همکاری‌های دفاعی و امنیتی میان سه کشور است. #طلوع‌نیوز

On the anniversary of the abrogation of Article 370, Pawan Khera called the move a ‘black deed’, & demanded the restoration of statehood for Kashmir. #CutTheClutter looks at how this stand differs from that of Jawaharlal Nehru’s & returns to the fascinating Parliament debate in November 1963, when the then PM said Kashmir’s integration is complete & Article 370 is temporary. 2. In 1963, national morale was down in India after the trauma of the 1962 war with China. Nehru’s health was declining steeply. Kashmir still had a prime minister instead of a chief minister, a Sadr-e-Riyasat instead of a Governor, & its MPs were nominated by the Assembly — not directly elected. 3. This was when, Nehru — on November 27, 1963 — stood up in Parliament & said Kashmir’s special status was now wearing off. Kashmir was already fully integrated, & Article 370 was passing through a process of “gradual erosion”. Nehru also said he will not use the power of the Parliament to abrogate this, but wait for J&K assembly to make that request after which it would be done. 4. This was a politically divisive issue — sections of the opposition, particularly the Bharatiya Jana Sangh, were very keen for this special status to end immediately. But, as the Parliament debate shows, Left, Right and Centre were all committed to the same idea — that this is a temporary provision & should go. The only difference was over the pace. 5. Parliament also debated steps underway. Presidential Orders under Article 370 were steadily extending provisions of the Indian Constitution to J&K — legal & medical professions & laws relating to welfare of labour & coal mining industry. Soon after, J&K’s PM became CM & Sadr-e-Riyasat became Governor. 6. A couple of highlights from the debate: · When HV Kamath of the Praja Socialist Party interjected to say J&K was not fully integrated, Nehru replied, saying “No, I repeat that it is fully integrated. The fact that there may be some special matters attached to it does not come in the way of integration at all.” · When Congress’s PC Borooah asked if govt would seek the opinion of the people of J&K in this matter, Nehru said, normally an elected assembly is supposed to represent the people. One does not take a referendum in such a matter. 7. On one aspect, though, Nehru did support retaining safeguards. He believed restrictions on outsiders buying land in Kashmir were sensible protections, comparing them to safeguards in tribal & border regions like NEFA & parts of Assam. But he did not regard those protections as evidence that Kashmir remained outside India’s constitutional integration. He had great clarity, & it seems his legatees haven’t read his parliamentary record or his views. 8. #CutTheClutter with me. However, legislative business has continued. Bills have been passed, and in the Rajya Sabha, all NDA members participated in the debates and presented their views. There should be no confusion that the Houses are not functioning. Parliament has been functioning and bills have been passed. The only difference is that fewer discussions have taken place because of the disruptions. That is the first clarification. Second, there has been no proposal so far for a special session. Third, the Union Home Minister, Amit Shah, remains in Parliament from morning until late at night. Therefore, such demands amount to political theatrics. I have said the same inside the House. Which minister speaks, when they speak, and on which subject is decided by the House with the approval of the Chairman. Under the principle of collective responsibility, it is not for the Opposition to decide which minister should speak on a particular issue. Therefore, the Chairman's directions should not be misinterpreted. I want to reiterate that when Home Minister Amit Shah speaks, the Opposition will have to sit quietly and listen. With 60% of rural households globally keeping livestock – and 93% in sub-Saharan Africa – livestock is central to rural transformation. For millions of small-scale producers, livestock is not only a source of food and income, but also an asset base, a buffer against shocks and a pathway into markets. This is why IFAD partners with governments to scale up investment in the sector. Our approach focuses on primary production, stronger value chains and an enabling policy and regulatory environment: the foundations needed to turn livestock from a subsistence activity into a driver of rural transformation. Since 2010, IFAD has invested US$6.1 billion in the sector, reflecting the tangible returns livestock delivers. Livestock is a primary target in 21% of IFAD projects and is included in 44% of IFAD investments. In #Cameroon, the AEP-Youth programme shows how targeted support can help rural young people build viable agropastoral enterprises. By combining access to finance, technical training, business incubation and market linkages, the programme reached more than 30,000 young people, supported over 3,000 new businesses and helped generate nearly 15,000 jobs. The results were measurable: livestock production increased by 152%, gross income by 151% and unprocessed livestock sales by 109% on average. When livestock investments are paired with training, market access, collective organization and supportive institutions, they strengthen food security, build resilience and stimulate local economic activity. NITI TARA (Toolkit for Analysis, Review & Action) is transforming data into action at the grassroots. With 200+ capacity-building sessions conducted across the country, over 4,000 officials from districts and blocks have been empowered to leverage data-driven insights for evidence-based decision-making. From interactive multi-sectoral dashboards and intuitive visualisations to collaborative planning tools, NITI TARA is simplifying reviews, strengthening inter-departmental coordination, and enabling more effective governance across India. Officials across regions have also highlighted the impact of SMRITI (System for Meeting Recording, Information & Transcription Interface), developed in collaboration with BHASHINI. By automating meeting minutes and enabling multilingual translation, SMRITI is enhancing operational efficiency and making governance more inclusive at the last mile. As the nationwide rollout gathers momentum, NITI TARA continues to convert capacity building into measurable action, empowering administrators to drive informed, responsive, and citizen-centric governance. Why Is the Modi Government Forcing E20 on India? ➤ Countries around the world took decades to transition to higher ethanol blends. Brazil took over 50 years to reach E20, while countries like the US and Germany still use E10 or lower. ➤ India, however, forced E20 within just 3 years, without adequately preparing petrol pump storage tanks, fuel transport infrastructure, or millions of vehicles, resulting in 25–30% lower mileage, fuel system failures, and engine damage. ➤ The United States is the world's largest ethanol producer, yet it still uses E10. India imported 1 billion litres of ethanol from the US last year and is expected to import 5 billion litres this year, raising serious questions about why E20 is being pushed so aggressively. -@ArvindKejriwal, National Convenor, AAP Video

India’s female labour market is expanding, but too many women are entering part-time jobs instead of secure, full-time employment. Between 2018 and 2024, the share of part-time employment in India rose from 14.7% to 24.4%. But the gender divide is striking. In 2024: •46.7% of employed women worked part-time, compared with just 14.3% of employed men •Nearly one in two employed women worked part-time, compared with one in seven men •The gender gap widened sharply—from 18 percentage points in 2018 to 32.4 percentage points in 2024. Part-time work can provide valuable flexibility and enable people with care responsibilities to remain in the labour force. International evidence shows that women are, in general, more likely than men to work part-time. But India stands out for the scale of this gender gap. So, what is driving the trend? The expansion of the gig and platform economy has created more flexible, task-based work opportunities. Persistent unpaid care responsibilities continue to constrain women's ability to take up full-time employment, making part-time work an important way to stay economically active. The concern, therefore, is not the rise of part-time work itself. It is whether women have a genuine choice between part-time and full-time employment. When women are disproportionately concentrated in part-time work because of care constraints and limited access to suitable full-time jobs, flexibility can come at the cost of lower earnings, weaker social protection and fewer opportunities for career progression and leadership. Looking ahead: The policy challenge is to improve the quality of part-time work, while also expanding women's access to quality full-time employment. This means: Extending appropriate social protection and benefits to part-time workers. •Creating pathways for women to transition into full-time and career-track roles. •Strengthening affordable childcare and care infrastructure. •Promoting genuinely family-friendly workplaces. •Expanding the supply of quality full-time jobs that are compatible with women's lives and aspirations. The goal should not simply be more women in employment, but more women with access to decent, secure and career-enhancing employment. #LabourMarkets #FemaleEmployment #GigEconomy #FutureOfWork #GenderAndWork #EPWD #ICRIER

How Ukrainians🇺🇦 STOP Russian inflitration attempts Russian army isn't stupid - they know that sending armored columns or platoons of men will get them absolutely torched by our drones. And that's why they had switched to a new tactic. Instead of sending human\armor waves, they instead send smaller units of 1-3 men to bypass our defences, hide in the tree lines and ruins, then wait for another group to join them and push on. Now, this tactic has plenty of weaknesses. And that's how we at #Rubizh exploit those: Small groups are difficult to detect, but they possess very little combat power. Once discovered, they can be isolated and destroyed separately. Losing even one soldier may cost a group half its firepower, its commander or its radio operator. They also have little ability to evacuate casualties or survive a direct engagement. The key is preventing these groups from accumulating. Our drones continuously search the space between positions, watching approaches, shelters and suspected movement routes. One Russian may slip through unnoticed, but every additional group, supply run or motorcycle increases the chance of exposing the entire hiding place. We also target the system supporting the infiltrators. Russian soldiers must often travel several kilometres carrying their own ammunition, water and batteries. Strikes against transport, supply routes and staging areas leave those who reach the front exhausted, undersupplied and isolated. Obstacles and remote mining further restrict their movement and make their routes more predictable. If infiltrators reach a tree line or ruined building, Ukrainian forces try to contain them before they can form a real foothold. Drones, artillery and local clearing forces locate and destroy the isolated groups while preventing reinforcements from reaching them. Most importantly, infiltration is not the same as territorial control. A Russian soldier planting a flag inside a settlement does not mean Russia controls it. Without reinforcements, supplies and heavy weapons, such groups may be trapped inside a grey zone with no reliable way forward or back. However, just because we know how to counter it does not mean it isn't a dangerous tactic. It exploits many gaps in our defences and forces us to use our manpower to hunt for scattered infiltrated soldiers while more of them keep coming in. But once the infiltrators lose concealment, the tactic turns against them. They are left exhausted, isolated and without the combat power needed to hold the ground they entered.

Greetings to everyone on National Handloom Day. Instituted in 2015 under the visionary leadership of Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi, this day celebrates India's rich handloom heritage, the exceptional craftsmanship of our weavers, and the spirit of self-reliance. It also commemorates the launch of the Swadeshi Movement in 1905, which inspired the nation to embrace indigenous products and strengthen economic self-reliance. PM Modi has consistently championed India's handloom sector through the vision of "Vocal for Local." Through several transformative initiatives, our Government has been promoting handloom products, expanding market access, improving weavers' welfare, preserving traditional crafts, and encouraging every citizen to make locally made products an integral part of everyday life. Let us celebrate our weavers, preserve India's timeless weaving traditions, and reaffirm our commitment to Vocal for Local by proudly choosing handloom products.

মক্কার মসজিদে হারাম ও মদিনার মসজিদে নববিতে আজ (শুক্রবার, ০৭ আগস্ট) জুমার নামাজের ইমামতি করবেন ও খুতবা দেবেন যারা, তারা হচ্ছেন প্রখ্যাত দুই শায়খ। মসজিদে হারাম কর্তৃপক্ষ এই তথ্য জানিয়েছে। মসজিদে হারাম আজ মসজিদে হারামে জুমার নামাজ পড়াবেন সুপ্রসিদ্ধ ইসলামিক স্কলার আলেম ও কারি শায়খ ফয়সাল গাজ্জাবী। তার বাবার নাম জামিল, দাদার নাম হাসান। ১৯৬৫ সালে তিনি সৌদি আরবের মক্কায় জন্মগ্রহণ করেন। শায়খ ফয়সাল গাজ্জাবী মক্কার উম্মুল কুরা ইউনিভার্সিটি থেকে মাস্টার্স ও পিএইচডি ডিগ্রি অর্জন করেন যথাক্রমে ১৯৯৬ এবং ২০০২ সালে। তিনি ২০০৮ সালে মসজিদে হারামের ইমাম এবং ২০১৬ সালে মসজিদে হারামের খতিব নিযুক্ত হন। উম্মুল কুরা ইউনিভার্সিটির কোরআন তিলাওয়াত অনুষদের প্রেসিডেন্টও তিনি। মসজিদে নববি মসজিদে নববিতে আজ জুমার নামাজ পড়াবেন মদিনার প্রসিদ্ধ ইমাম, বিশিষ্ট ইসলামিক স্কলার ও খতিব শায়খ ড. আবদুল্লাহ বিন আবদুর রহমান আল বুয়াইজান। তিনি মদিনা ইসলামিক ইউনিভার্সিটির ফ্যাকাল্টি মেম্বার। তিনি বাদশাহ সালমান বিন আবদুল আজিজ আলে সৌদের রাজকীয় আদেশে ২০১৬ সালের সেপ্টেম্বর মাসে মসজিদে নববির খতিব হিসেবে নিয়োগ পান। এর আগে ১৪৩৪ হিজরিতে তাকে বাদশাহ আবদুল্লাহ তাকে ইমাম হিসেবে নিয়োগ দেন। চমৎকার ও হৃদয়গ্রাহী কোরআন তেলাওয়াতের জন্য শায়খ বুয়াইজান বিশ্বব্যাপী পরিচিত। সূত্র: ইসলামিক ইনফরম্যাশন #JummahMubarak #muslim #IslamicNews #somoytv

Glimpses from Day 1 of the BRICS Cultural Festival at Ravindra Bhawan, Bhopal, held under the theme “Sarve Bhavantu Sukhinah” (May All Be Happy). The opening day celebrated the vibrant cultural diversity of BRICS nations through captivating performances by participating countries. Belarus enthralled the audience with traditional folk songs and comic dances, Brazil showcased the dynamic art of Capoeira, Indonesia presented the graceful Pushpanjali, Russia mesmerised with a performance by a quartet of distinguished soloists, and the United Arab Emirates was represented by acclaimed Emirati musician Mr. Saif AlAli, whose performance reflected the richness of Emirati and Arab musical traditions. As the host nation, India captivated the audience with “Maru Rang – The Heritage of Rajasthan,” featuring the vibrant folk traditions of Rajasthan through spectacular performances of Ghoomar, Chari, Kalbelia, and Bhawai, celebrating India’s rich and living cultural heritage. The festival reaffirmed the power of culture in fostering dialogue, mutual understanding, and people-to-people connections among BRICS nations. #CultureUnitesAll #BRICS2026 @BricsIndia2026

U.S. intelligence now assesses that Vladimir Putin could test NATO's resolve with a limited attack on a member state within the next several years, marking a shift from earlier assessments that Russia would avoid provoking the alliance while the war in Ukraine continued. According to The Wall Street Journal, U.S. intelligence believes potential scenarios range from cyberattacks and hybrid operations using unmarked forces to a limited land incursion, with the risk increasing between now and 2029. Officials reportedly assess Putin may be more willing to take risks as Russia faces mounting pressure from Ukrainian strikes, slowing battlefield gains, and domestic expectations for victory. The report also ties the assessment to growing concerns over U.S. munitions stockpiles. Officials cited shortages of key weapons, including Patriot interceptors, THAAD interceptors, Stingers, Precision Strike Missiles (PrSM), and ATACMS, following years of aid to Ukraine and heavy expenditure during Operation Epic Fury against Iran. The Pentagon and White House dispute those concerns, with Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell calling reports of shortages "false" and the White House maintaining the U.S. has sufficient munitions to meet all strategic objectives.

कविगुरु गुरुदेव रवींद्रनाथ टैगोर जी की पुण्यतिथि पर उन्हें कोटि-कोटि नमन। गुरुदेव टैगोर जी ने अपनी लेखनी से भारत की आत्मा को स्वर दिया और स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन में नई चेतना का संचार किया। उनकी अमर कृति 'जन गण मन' राष्ट्र की एकात्म चेतना और आत्मगौरव का प्रतीक है। विश्व भारती विश्वविद्यालय की स्थापना कर कविगुरु ने भारतीय संस्कृति, दर्शन और शिक्षा के वैभव को विश्व पटल पर प्रतिष्ठित किया। उनका साहित्य आज भी करोड़ों देशवासियों के लिए प्रेरणा का अक्षय स्रोत है। কবিগুরু রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুরের প্রয়াণ দিবসে তাঁকে জানাই কোটি কোটি প্রণাম। নিজের অনন্য সাহিত্যসৃষ্টির মাধ্যমে কবিগুরু রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুর ভারতবর্ষের আত্মাকে কণ্ঠস্বর দিয়েছেন এবং স্বাধীনতা আন্দোলনে নতুন চেতনার সঞ্চার করেছেন। তাঁর অমর সৃষ্টি 'জন গণ মন' আমাদের জাতীয় ঐক্য, আত্মমর্যাদা ও দেশপ্রেমের চিরন্তন প্রতীক। বিশ্বভারতী বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় প্রতিষ্ঠার মাধ্যমে তিনি ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতি, দর্শন ও শিক্ষার গৌরবকে বিশ্বদরবারে প্রতিষ্ঠিত করেছেন। তাঁর সাহিত্য, দর্শন ও চিন্তাধারা আজও কোটি কোটি ভারতবাসীর কাছে অনুপ্রেরণার এক অক্ষয় উৎস।

18 years ago today, Dan Kaminsky @dakami disclosed the DNS cache poisoning vulnerability at Black Hat USA 2008, triggering one of the largest coordinated patch efforts in internet history. Before public disclosure, Dan organized multiple vendors to fix the flaw in secret. Many more legendary stories than could fit here, like how he exposed Sony’s rootkit across more than 568,000 networks and identified critical certificate vulnerabilities. Dan followed what he cared about and his curiosity. As Michael Tiffany @kubla put it, “Only Dan thought, ‘I could fix the human eye in software.’” He built DanKam, an augmented-reality app that helped colorblind people see color. Michael hosted Dan while he built the first version and described watching a colorblind houseguest sit at the kitchen table, “crying tears of joy seeing red for the first time.” His mother, Trudy Maurer, may have said it best when she accepted his Lifetime Achievement Award at the 2025 Difference Makers. “Daniel was the catalyst for many achievements across the vast internet spectrum, and I believe Dan truly represented the intersection of technology and humanity.” @dotMudge, who presented the award, said: “The Lifetime Achievement Award isn’t about what you achieve in your lifetime. That’s part of it. It’s about how many people you influence and bring in and then take it further.” We lost Dan too early from diabetic ketoacidosis in April 2021 at age 42. Some of you are hearing the name Dan Kaminsky for the first time. The coordinated, community-first spirit Dan modeled is the bar. If you're in Vegas this week, you're walking the streets that the legends of security who came before you walked, when they also had no idea what they were doing, facing problems nobody had solved before. They had to figure it out as they went. Just like you're going to do. We aim to further diversify gas supply routes. Ukraine has proposed creating a strategic energy security bridge with Canada focused on the supply of Canadian LNG to Ukraine. Following the agreements reached by President of Ukraine @ZelenskyyUa and Prime Minister of Canada @MarkJCarney, we discussed with the Minister the preparation and benefits of concluding a long-term 30-year strategic energy agreement. We discussed Ukraine’s preparations for the upcoming winter, including the possibility of direct grant support from Canada for gas purchases for Ukraine in the amount of CAD 650 million, as part of the overall support package for Ukraine this year. Ukraine also invited Canadian suppliers to use Ukrainian underground gas storage facilities. Another important topic was the supply of energy equipment from Canadian manufacturers to Ukraine. We also touched upon nuclear energy cooperation. Ukraine is interested in Canada’s experience and opportunities in the development of SMRs — small modular reactors. We agreed that this area will become part of our strategic energy agreement. I thanked my colleague for Canada’s unwavering support for Ukraine and for Minister Hodgson’s personal role in advancing our energy partnership at various levels. We highly value the assistance provided through the Ukraine Energy Support Fund. 🇰🇵 North Korea fires a ballistic missile ahead of US-South Korea war games North Korea launched a short-range ballistic missile toward the sea off its east coast on Thursday, South Korea’s military said, its first such test in more than 40 days. The missile was detected launching from the Wonsan area around 5 p.m. local time, according to South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff. Japan’s Defense Ministry said it landed in the sea off North Korea’s coast with no impact on Japanese territory. South Korea’s presidential office convened an emergency security meeting and condemned the launch as a violation of UN Security Council resolutions, while its military raised its alert level. The test comes days before the US and South Korea are due to begin their annual joint military exercises this month. Washington and Seoul call the drills defensive; Pyongyang has long denounced them as rehearsals for an invasion, and has often timed weapons tests to coincide with them. The launch was North Korea’s first since late June, when it tested a tactical missile with what it called a “special mission” warhead.

We have stood with the Tiananmen Mothers and countless other victims of political persecution, documenting abuses, advocating for accountability, and amplifying the voices of those whom the Chinese government seeks to silence. No sanctions imposed by the Chinese government will deter us from our mission. On the contrary, this action underscores the importance of our work. HRIC will continue to stand with human rights defenders, support victims of persecution, and advocate for a China where the rights and dignity of every person are respected. شماری از علما و متنفذان جامعه هزاره‌ و شیعه در واکنش به دستور تخلیه شهرک «امید سبز» از سوی وزیر عدلیه طالبان، با نشر بیانیه‌‌ای گفتند که رفتارها و اقدامات این وزیر طالبان، «مصداق تبعیض سیستماتیک و اقدام برای کوچ‌اجباری مردم هزاره و شیعه است و تداوم آن غیرقابل تحمل می‌باشد». این بیانیه‌ شام امروز (پنج‌شنبه، ‌۱۵ اسد) در اعتراض به آنچه «رفتارها و اقدامات توهین و تبعیض‌آمیز» وزیر عدلیه طالبان خوانده شده، نشر شده است. علما و متنفذان هزاره‌ و شیعه از طالبان خواسته‌اند که جلو رفتارهای تبعیض‌آمیز وزیر عدلیه خود علیه مردم اهل تشیع را بگیرد. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258620

وزارت ارشاد، حج و اوقاف طالبان در خطبه‌ی نماز جمعه که قرار است فردا در مساجد تبلیغ شود، با استناد به حدیثی گفته است که «زن عورت است، اگر از خانه خارج شود، مورد توجه شیطان قرار می‌گیرد». در این خطبه آمده است که زنان در خانه بمانند و به شوهران‌شان خدمت کنند. این خطبه تحت عنوان «اهمیت و ضرورت حفاظت نظام خانوادگی از دیدگاه اسلام» امروز (پنج‌شنبه، ۱۵ اسد) در صفحه‌ی ایکس وزارت ارشاد، حج و اوقاف طالبان نشر شده است. در بخشی از این خطبه درباره‌ی مسئولیت زنان در خانواده آمده و گفته شده است که برای پایداری نظام خانواده، دین اسلام به زنان دستور داده است که از شوهران خود اطاعت کنند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258616

चीन-पाकिस्तान की बढ़ी टेंशन! भारत ने 'अग्नि-4' मिसाइल का सफल परीक्षण किया मध्यम दूरी की बैलिस्टिक मिसाइल 'अग्नि-4' का कामयाबी के साथ परीक्षण कर लिया गया है. 6 अगस्त 2026 को ओडिशा के चांदीपुर में मौजूद इंटीग्रेटेड टेस्ट रेंज से सफलतापूर्वक परीक्षण किया गया. इस लॉन्च से सभी ऑपरेशनल और टेक्निकल पैरामीटर्स की पुष्टि हुई. यह परीक्षण स्ट्रैटजिक फोर्सेज कमांड की देखरेख में किया गया. अग्नि-4 मिसाइल भारत की स्वदेशी मिसाइल है, जो ठोस ईंधन से चलती है. इसमें कम दूरी से लेकर अंतरमहाद्वीपीय दूरी तक हमला करने वाली मिसाइलें शामिल हैं. इन मिसाइलों को सड़क और रेल दोनों माध्यमों से तैनात किया जा सकता है, जिससे युद्ध की स्थिति में इनके बचने और जवाबी हमला करने की क्षमता बढ़ जाती है. . . अग्नि मिसाइल परियोजना की शुरुआत 1980 के दशक की शुरुआत में इंटीग्रेटेड गाइडेड मिसाइल डेवलपमेंट प्रोग्राम (IGMDP) के तहत हुई थी. इस कार्यक्रम का नेतृत्व भारत के पूर्व राष्ट्रपति और प्रसिद्ध वैज्ञानिक डॉ. एपीजे अब्दुल कलाम ने किया था. तब से भारत ने अग्नि मिसाइल की कई नई सीरीज तैयार की हैं. मिसाइल के इंजन में मौजूद ठोस ईंधन जलता है. इससे अत्यधिक गर्म गैसें बनती हैं, जो पीछे लगे नोजल से बाहर निकलती हैं.इसी प्रतिक्रिया से आगे की दिशा में जोर पैदा होता है और मिसाइल ऊपर उठती है. उड़ान भरने के लिए थ्रस्ट का मिसाइल के वजन से अधिक होना जरूरी होता है. जब पूरा ईंधन समाप्त हो जाता है तो मिसाइल अपनी अधिकतम गति हासिल कर चुकी होती है. भारत के लिए अग्नि-4 का सफल परीक्षण ना सिर्फ एक तकनीकी उपलब्धि नहीं, बल्कि चीन और पाकिस्तान के लिए भारत के रणनीतिक संदेश के तौर पर भी देखा जाता है. तकरीबन 4000km की मारक क्षमता वाली यह मिसाइल पूरे पाकिस्तान और चीन के बड़े हिस्से तक पहुंच सकती है. इसके जरिए भारत किसी भी संभावित खतरे का प्रभावी जवाब देने की क्षमता बनाए रखता है. #AgniMissile #Agni #MissileTest

Lahiri, Vice Chairperson, NITI Aayog, delivered the keynote address at the Department of Economic Affairs–Asian Development Bank (ADB) Joint Consultation Workshop on ADB's Country Partnership Strategy (CPS) 2028–2032. The workshop brought together senior officials from the Government of India, State Governments, ADB, industry, and development partners to deliberate on priorities for India's next phase of development. In his address, Dr. Lahiri highlighted the importance of aligning the next Country Partnership Strategy with India's journey towards Viksit Bharat by 2047. He identified deeper integration into global value chains and the development of City Economic Regions as two key priorities, while emphasising the need to strengthen MSMEs, promote private sector participation, and enhance competitiveness through technology, innovation, and better market integration. He also underscored the importance of a stronger sub-national approach, greater financial empowerment of urban local bodies, and continued collaboration between ADB, the Government of India, and States to drive sustainable, inclusive, and resilient development. मुंबईला जागतिक क्रिएटिव्ह इकॉनॉमीचे नेतृत्व करणारे केंद्र बनविण्याच्या दिशेने महत्त्वपूर्ण पाऊल मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते आज दादासाहेब फाळके चित्रनगरी, मुंबई येथे 'प्राईम फोकस स्टुडिओ - फेज 1'चे उद्घाटन करण्यात आले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, प्राईम फोकस स्टुडिओच्या फेज-1 चे उद्घाटन हा केवळ एका इमारतीचा शुभारंभ नसून, मुंबईला जागतिक दर्जाच्या क्रिएटिव्ह इकॉनॉमीचे नेतृत्व करणारे केंद्र म्हणून विकसित करण्याच्या दिशेने टाकलेले महत्त्वपूर्ण पाऊल आहे. या माध्यमातून भारतातील मनोरंजन क्षेत्राला जागतिक स्तरावर नवी ओळख आणि बळकटी मिळणार असून यामुळे मुंबईत अत्याधुनिक दर्जाच्या सेवा उपलब्ध होतील. 'वेव्ह्ज 2025' मध्ये करण्यात आलेल्या सामंजस्य करारानंतर अवघ्या वर्षभरात हा प्रकल्प पूर्ण करण्यात आला आहे. पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांनी भारताला ऑरेंज इकोनॉमीचे जागतिक केंद्र बनविण्याचा संकल्प केला असून, प्राईम फोकससारख्या संस्था त्या संकल्पनेला प्रत्यक्षात साकार करत आहेत. अत्याधुनिक तंत्रज्ञान, जागतिक दर्जाच्या सुविधा आणि आधुनिक पायाभूत संरचनेमुळे भारतातील मनोरंजन क्षेत्राला नवे व्यासपीठ मिळणार असून, देशातील युवांना जागतिक स्तरावर काम करण्याच्या नव्या संधी उपलब्ध होणार आहेत, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले, आपल्याकडे असंख्य वैविध्यपूर्ण कथा आहेत. आपली संस्कृती आणि सांस्कृतिक परंपरा अत्यंत समृद्ध आहे आणि त्या वारशाचा प्रत्येक पैलू एक वेगळी कथा सांगतो. आता जगाने आपल्या सांस्कृतिक वारशात आणि इतिहासात दडलेल्या या सर्व कथा जाणून घेण्याची वेळ आली आहे. 'क्रिएटर इकॉनॉमी' आणि तिच्याभोवती निर्माण झालेली परिसंस्था भारताला या क्षेत्रात जागतिक नेतृत्व करण्याची सुवर्णसंधी देत आहे. या संपूर्ण प्रवासाचे नेतृत्व करण्यासाठी आवश्यक जागतिक दर्जाच्या पायाभूत सुविधा, अत्याधुनिक तंत्रज्ञान आणि क्षमता प्राईम फोकस स्टुडिओच्या या कार्यालयात उपलब्ध असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. आगामी 'रामायण' हा चित्रपट याच स्टुडिओमध्ये साकार होत असून, तो भारतीय चित्रपटसृष्टीच्या इतिहासातील मैलाचा दगड ठरेल, असे नमूद करतानाच मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, लवकरच संपूर्ण फिल्म सिटीचा जागतिक दर्जाच्या रूपात पुनर्विकास करण्याची योजना प्रत्यक्षात आणली जाईल. यावेळी मंत्री ॲड. आशिष शेलार, डीएनईजीचे ग्लोबल सीईओ व प्राईम फोकस लिमिटेडचे संस्थापक नमित मल्होत्रा आणि इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @narendramodi @Dev_Fadnavis @ShelarAshish @malhotra_namit @PF__Studios @PrimeFocusIndia @dneg #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #PrimeFocusStudios

We also discussed the need to continue to protect and support frontline health and community workers, including by ensuring they have adequate personal protective equipment, and are compensated for their work. We agreed on the need to strengthen collaboration across the Ebola response and wider humanitarian efforts. When Barry Eichengreen—the leading authority on the international monetary system and reserve currencies—raises concerns this serious about the US dollar's reserve status, we should pay close attention. The dollar's reserve status rests on a simple but fundamental assumption: foreign central banks are free to deploy their reserves as they see fit, especially by selling US Treasuries when circumstances require. If that assumption no longer holds because reserve managers fear political pressure from Washington, then the rationale for holding large dollar reserves inevitably begins to erode. Yes, the BOJ can access the Fed's FIMA Repo Facility. But what about those central banks that cannot? More importantly, should reserve managers have to rely on the goodwill of the issuer simply to access the liquidity of their own reserve assets? The US government's apparent anxiety over foreign central banks selling Treasuries may itself pose one of the greatest question marks on the dollar's reserve status. Luke Gromen (@LukeGromen) If UST reserves cannot be sold in a crisis without making said crisis worse by threatening a debt spiral, then UST’s are no longer fit for purpose as FX reserves. The 19th round of India-Singapore Foreign Office Consultations (FOC) was held on 06 August 2026, in New Delhi. The two sides reviewed the progress of bilateral cooperation under the eight key areas outlined by the Roadmap for India-Singapore Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP Roadmap) that will be taken up under India-Singapore Ministerial Roundtable (ISMR). The two sides also exchanged views on regional and global developments and reaffirmed the importance of close coordination at international and regional fora, including ASEAN, in addressing shared challenges. India-Singapore relations were elevated to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership during the visit of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi to Singapore in September 2024. The Roadmap for Comprehensive Strategic Partnership was launched during the visit of H.E. Mr. Lawrence Wong, Prime Minister of Singapore to India in September 2025, and covers cooperation in the areas of (1) Economic Cooperation, (2) Skills Development, (3) Digitalisation, (4) Sustainability, (5) Connectivity, (6) Healthcare and Medicine, (7) People-to-People and Cultural Exchanges and (8) Defence and Security Cooperation.

Today, Zelenskyy, Starmer, Macron, and Merz meet in London. The format itself is worth welcoming, even if the EU has once again been left on the sidelines. The real question is what mindset the E3 brings to the table. Zelenskyy set the tone with his open letter to Putin. While his European partners likely share its substance, they are unlikely to be ready to openly put their signatures beneath it. But they do see that Russia is not looking for middle ground. It is set on war. Seeking a balanced compromise with an aggressor committed to conquest is not diplomacy. It is self-deception. The predecessors of today’s leaders understood this well. Symbolically, eighty-five years ago, London hosted another gathering. In June 1941, representatives of fourteen Allied governments and liberation movements met there to unite against Nazism. The final London Declaration was not about ending a war. It was about uniting those willing to win it and shape the peace that followed. One can only hope today’s meeting is guided by the same logic. Europe’s prosperity depends on its security. Europe’s security depends on Ukraine. It is time to turn that truth into effective policy. And fast.

Under the chairmanship of Hon'ble Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi Ji, the Union Cabinet has approved the following key decisions: • Approval of the GOBARdhan, the National Circular Bioenergy Scheme with a total outlay of ₹23,731 crore. To be implemented from FY 2026-27 to FY 2035-36, the scheme will convert agricultural residue, cattle dung, municipal organic waste and other biomass into compressed biogas, organic manure and additional rural income, while strengthening India's clean energy transition and circular economy. • Approval for the development of the 135.871 km, 4-lane access-controlled Guwahati-Tezpur Corridor on NH-15 in Assam at a total cost of ₹8,970.20 crore under the Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) Toll mode. The project includes a 4.9 km Emergency Landing Facility on the Tezpur Bypass, developed in coordination with the Indian Air Force, which will improve strategic connectivity while easing congestion on NH-27 along the south bank of the Brahmaputra. #CabinetDecisions

Srinivas, Member (Health), NITI Aayog, addressed the Orientation Programme of the 3rd Batch of the Master of Public Health (MPH) Programme at the National Institute of Health and Family Welfare (NIHFW). Congratulating the incoming students, he emphasised that addressing today's complex health challenges requires a multidisciplinary and future-ready public health workforce. He highlighted that the diverse academic backgrounds of MPH students, combined with experiential learning and collaborative field exposure, would equip them to strengthen health systems through evidence-based policymaking, innovation, and leadership. Prof. Srinivas also spoke about the wide range of opportunities available to MPH graduates across public health administration, research, academia, and policymaking. Minister for Foreign Affairs Hon. Mr Shisir Khanal today officially launched the Nepal e-Attestation System (NEATS), developed by the Department of Consular Services. Addressing the launching ceremony, the Hon. Minister underscored the importance of digitalising consular services and expressed confidence that NEATS would make services easier, more accessible, transparent and predictable, while modernising service delivery in line with international best practices. Following the implementation of NEATS from 1 Bhadra 2083 (17 August 2026), applicants will be able to apply for consular attestation online, track their application status, make payments and book an appointment before visiting the Department. The system is expected to minimise processing delays and make the service more efficient, transparent and service-friendly.

تیم ملی فوتسال افغانستان در چهارمین مسابقه‌ی خود در جام بین‌ قاره‌ای (کانتیننتال)، شش بر یک نیوزیلند را شکست داد. نیمه‌ی اول این بازی که امروز (پنج‌شنبه، ۱۵ اسد) در تایلند برگزار شد، چهار بر صفر به نفع ملی‌پوشان افغانستان پایان یافت. این گل‌ها توسط امید قنبری (دو بار)، مهران غلامی و جواد حیدری به ثمر رسیدند. با آغاز نیمه‌ی دوم، ملی‌پوشان نیوزیلند یک گل را جبران کردند، اما در ادامه افغانستان با درخشش اکبر کاظمی، کاپیتان تیم، به دو گل دیگر نیز رسید و بازی با نتیجه‌ی شش بر یک پایان یافت. تیم ملی فوتسال افغانستان در سه بازی قبلی، در برابر روسیه مساوی کرد و در مقابل تیم‌های تایلند و ویتنام باخت.

یک دادگاه در آلمان یک شهروند افغانستان را به‌دلیل حمله با موتر به جمعیت در شهر مونیخ که به کشته‌شدن یک دختر دوساله و مادرش و زخمی‌شدن ده‌ها نفر دیگر انجامید، به حبس ابد محکوم کرد. به گزارش خبرگزاری فرانسه، دادگاه شهر مونیخ روز پنج‌شنبه (۱۵ اسد) فرد متهم را که با نام «فرهاد ن.» معرفی شده است، به دو فقره قتل، ۲۳ فقره اقدام به قتل و ۲۲ فقره واردکردن آسیب بدنی مجرم شناخت. دادگاه همچنین اعلام کرد که این پرونده از «شدت ویژه‌ی جرم» برخوردار است؛ تصمیمی که احتمال آزادی فرهاد ۲۵ ساله را در آینده به‌شدت کاهش می‌دهد. جزئیات بیشتر: etilaatroz.com/258596

He identified deeper integration into global value chains and the development of City Economic Regions as two key priorities, while emphasising the need to strengthen MSMEs, promote private sector participation, and enhance competitiveness through technology, innovation, and better market integration. He also underscored the importance of a stronger sub-national approach, greater financial empowerment of urban local bodies, and continued collaboration between ADB, the Government of India, and States to drive sustainable, inclusive, and resilient development. Naqvi is no ordinary minister. He is seen to be the “factotum” of Asim Munir — a trusted political operator who rose from journalism to Punjab CM, PCB chairman &, finally, Interior Minister. This, despite belonging to neither PML-N nor PPP. So, when he delivered a speech at a chamber of commerce on July 31, condemning Pakistan’s entire governing system, everyone took notice. 3. Naqvi’s speech has generated multiple interpretations in Pakistan. At one end, it’s seen as a message to politicians to invite Munir to become Pakistan President. At the most forgiving end, it’s being seen as the army wanting more money. It is unhappy with the post-18th Amendment federal structure, which devolved substantial financial & administrative powers to the provinces. 4. Then there’s a middle interpretation. In his speech, Naqvi argued Pakistan should consider creating administrative units or even additional provinces. Because provinces are too centralised & have too much power. Implications? Breaking up Punjab could dilute Sharif family’s dominance & splitting Sindh — or separating Karachi into a federally administered territory — would weaken PPP’s electoral base. 5. The most interesting bit in Naqvi’s speech was when he said there is one man who’s going around the world getting fame, joy & gains for Pakistan without crossing any red lines. Then he said issues should be resolved in 6 months, essentially putting the govt on notice. That’s the interpretation I buy. 6. #CutTheClutter with me: Pakistan Minister Naqvi reveals Munir's plan, puts govt on notice with his call for new provinces ￼ youtube.com/watch?v=Z67_jDgn…

But the vast majority of the world's offshore wind resources actually lie in deep water – beyond 60 meters – where fixed foundations become economically unviable due to soaring costs and technical complexity. Floating wind is the only technology that can unlock these deepwater resources. The "Haiyou Anlan," installed at a water depth of 136 meters and 136 kilometers off the coast, proves that China can now tap into this enormous potential. Google has rolled back a new Google Earth feature that let users generate AI images on top of its satellite imagery, following a backlash from the open-source research community, including CIR. The tool, launched last week, integrated Google's image-generation technology into Google Earth, allowing users to zoom into any location and create new pictures based on its satellite and 3D-mapping data. Google framed it as a way to visualise history and plan real estate projects. But researchers quickly warned it could be used to fabricate convincing fake satellite imagery, of explosions, military positions, or damage that never happened, on a platform that journalists and investigators rely on precisely because it is trusted. In a @FRANCE24 article, CIR Co-Founder @rwdburley called the feature "irresponsible," warning that "trust in satellite imagery has taken decades to build and could be irrevocably damaged overnight." That trust is central to open-source work - satellite imagery is one of the main tools CIR and others use to verify where and when an event took place. If audiences can no longer be confident that an image reflects reality, the cost is not just individual fakes but an erosion of the shared reference point that verification depends on. Google says it has paused the feature while it works on stronger safeguards. We welcome the decision and hope it reflects a wider recognition that tools capable of rewriting the visual record need serious guardrails before release, not after. 🇩🇪 Molbergen: Germany’s real demographic halo effect: While Gavrus in Normandy shows what a traditional Catholic institution can do to a tiny village. Molbergen (Cloppenburg district, Lower Saxony) is potentially more impressive again. This is a full rural municipality of over 9,000 people with 26.6% of its population being under the age of 18, or roughly 10 percentage points above the German average, with younger cohorts that keep getting larger. This produces the definition of a "Population Pryamid" which is seen in youthful, growing populations. Positive natural increase continues year after year with the driver being the same “halo” mechanism, but this time from a different source.. In the case of Molbergen it's the Spätaussiedler (Russlanddeutsche) from the former Soviet Union. Roughly every second resident has this background. Many belong to free churches (especially Pentecostal, Mennonite Brethern and Baptist communities) that still practise high fertility as a cultural and religious norm. Large families are common, churches are full, and the age pyramid looks nothing like the rest of Germany. Molbergen is a quiet, agricultural place west of Cloppenburg, typical of the Oldenburger Münsterland countryside and yet demographically it is an outlier of national significance. James (@InfoAtJames) 🇫🇷 Incidentally the Commune of Gavrus in Normandy is one of the clearest examples we have of FSSPX influence on a village's demographics in France. Around 27% of its residents are under 15, and roughly 32% under 18, ranking it approximately 289th out of nearly 35,000 French communes. This is firmly in the top 1%. Its average age is in the low 30s, unusually low for a village of about 650 people. The main reason is clearly the SSPX presence. The local traditional Catholic school and priory are a magnet for multi-child families. This, in turn produces a classic “halo effect” with families settling nearby so their children can attend the school and take part in traditional parish life, raising the local birth rate and keeping the age profile young. SSPX schools across France have shown steady growth in recent years, with several reporting rising enrolments as demand from traditional families increases. In Gavrus we see this pattern of institutional presence, which is visible and measurable at small area (commune level). It maintains a elevated share of children compared with similar-sized rural communes. Most places ranking higher (younger) than Gavrus (at commune level) are either tiny hamlets (where a few large families skew the numbers) or urban/suburban areas with high immigration. Among rural, non-immigrant communes of comparable size, Gavrus remains a clear outlier. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/InfoAtJames/status/2084549756957978626#m

With its strikes on Moscow, Ukraine is taking disruption to a new level. The success of a long-range strike is not measured by impact alone. Even an intercepted attack closes airspace, disrupts flights and logistics, and erodes the sense of security. Russia cannot protect everything. It has more targets than air defences. Hitting the target magnifies the effect, but disruption begins before destruction. Yes, Russia will continue firing ballistic missiles at Ukrainian cities. But Putin’s problem is that Ukrainian suffering will no longer compensate Russians for disruption at home. As that disruption spreads, Russians will increasingly blame Putin and his corrupt regime for breaking the central bargain underpinning his rule since 2022: war was supposed to be something Ukrainians suffer, not them. The choice is Putin’s: wind down the war to preserve control, or tighten control at home to keep the war going. I would love to be wrong, but everything we know about him suggests he will choose the latter.

The Second Session of the 6th ICWA-VASS Dialogue focused on the theme “Emerging Economic Opportunities in India–Viet Nam Relations” highlighted the immense potential for transforming the India–Viet Nam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership into a dynamic engine of economic growth and innovation. The session was Chaired by Assoc. Prof. Dr. Ta Minh Tuan, Vice President, Viet Nam Academy of Social Sciences. Dr. Prabir De @Prabir_India, Professor, Research and Information System for Developing Countries @RIS_NewDelhi and Dr. Phi Vinh Tuong, Deputy Director General, Institute of Vietnam and World Economy, Viet Nam Academy of Social Sciences, were the panellists. Dr. Saon Ray @SaonRay, Senior Visiting Professor, Indian Council for Research on International Economic Relations @ICRIER and Dr. Truong Quang Hoan, Director, Center for Southeast Asian Studies, Institute for Asia-Pacific Studies, Viet Nam Academy of Social Sciences, were discussants. The discussion underscored four key priorities: Firstly, building resilient joint value chains in semiconductors, critical minerals, pharmaceuticals, electronics, renewable energy, and advanced manufacturing. Secondly, establishing an India–Viet Nam Innovation Corridor to connect startups, universities, industries, and governments, fostering collaboration in AI, digital transformation, research, and technology. Third, enhancing trade facilitation and connectivity through improved logistics, digital payment interoperability, harmonised standards, and reduced non-tariff barriers to achieve and potentially surpass the bilateral trade target of US$25 billion by 2030. Lastly, converting the strong political partnership into concrete economic outcomes through greater investment, business-to-business engagement, provincial cooperation, and resilient supply chains. The session reaffirmed that while India and Viet Nam have built a robust strategic partnership, the next phase lies in unlocking their complementary strengths to create a future-oriented, innovation-driven economic partnership that contributes to regional prosperity and resilience.

ما در افغانستان در بخش‌ها و حوزه‌های مختلف علوم، منابع و متون تحلیلی آن‌چنانی نداریم. در زمینه‌ی نقد و نظریه‌ی ادبی نیز آثار و کتاب‌های خوب نداریم. مضمون نقد و نظریه‌ی ادبی در هیأت دانشی که به فلسفه‌ی ماهیت ادبیات می‌پردازد، از راه ترجمه از زبان‌های فرنگی وارد ایران و افغانستان شده است. بنابراین، نمی‌توان این دانش را دانش دیرپا و کهن‌سال قلمداد کرد. البته این به‌ معنای این نیست که در ادبیات فارسی دری در افغانستان هیچ‌گونه نگاه تحلیلی نسبت به ادبیات و آفریده‌های ادبی وجود نداشته، بل منظورم این است که دانش نقد ادبی به‌مثابه‌ی دانش روشمند، با اصول و مفاهیم روشن در سال‌های اخیر در دانشگاه‌ها و دانشکده‌های ادبیات مطرح شده است. در کل می‌توان گفت، از این‌که با نقد و نظریه‌ی ادبی آشنایی و معرفت عمیق شکل نگرفته و منتقدان زیادی در این حوزه ظهور نکرده، در نتیجه کتاب‌های غنامندی هم نگارش نیافته است. در ایران، دکتر حسین پاینده، استاد ادبیات در دانشگاه علامه طباطبایی، کتاب‌های ارزشمندی در حوزه‌ نقد و نظریه‌ی ادبی نوشته است. در افغانستان زنده‌یاد استاد محمدناصر رهیاب کتاب ارزشمندی در دو جلد با عنوان «شعر؛ هنر زبانی زیبا» نوشته است که می‌توان رویکردهای جدید به زبان، هنر و ادبیات را در آن پیدا کرد. برای نمونه از این دو شخصیت و کتاب‌های‌شان یاد کردم. شاید چهره‌های دیگر در ایران و افغانستان در این بخش قلم و قدم زده باشند که نقل‌شان در این کوتاهه نمی‌گنجد. در افغانستان اما، کتاب‌های زیادی در بخش نقد و نظریه نمی‌توان سراغ گرفت که به‌گونه‌ی فراگیر و روشمند مکتب‌ها، نظریه‌ها، اصول و مفاهیم نقد ادبی را به تحلیل و بررسی عمیق گرفته باشد. یکی از دلایل کم‌بنیگی نقد ادبی در افغانستان همین موضوع می‌باشد. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258570

The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) Center has issued a warning advisory after receiving a report from the master of a tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz, who reported hearing two explosions approximately 9 nautical miles southeast of Kumzar, Oman. According to UKMTO, the crew and vessel are safe, with no reported damage or environmental pollution. Authorities are investigating the incident. The reported location is notable as it lies in the same general area as several recent maritime security incidents, including an attack reported on August 3, highlighting the continued security risks to commercial shipping transiting the Strait of Hormuz.

The 47th ASEAN Senior Officials Meeting on Drug Matters (ASOD) and Its Related Meetings were convened via videoconference on 4-5 August 2026. The Meetings brought together ASOD Leaders from all ASEAN Member States, as well as senior officials responsible for preventing and combatting illicit drugs from ASEAN’s Dialogue Partners. The Deputy Secretary-General of ASEAN for the ASEAN Political-Security Community, H.E. Dato’ Astanah Abdul Aziz, represented the ASEAN Secretariat at the Meeting. The Meetings exchanged views on recent developments and emerging illicit drug trends in the region, with a focus on strengthening practical cooperation among ASEAN Member States and between ASEAN and its Dialogue Partners in addressing current threats and evolving challenges. The 47th ASOD also discussed, among others, the outcomes of the ASOD Working Group Meetings, preparations for the upcoming ASEAN Ministerial Meeting on Drug Matters (AMMD) in October and the Final Review of the ASEAN Work Plan on Securing Communities Against Illicit Drugs 2016-2025. The ASEAN Secretariat briefed the Meeting on recent developments in ASEAN. The series of meetings included ASOD Consultations with Australia, China, India, Japan, the Republic of Korea, Russia and the Plus Three countries.

The Meeting between the Committee of Permanent Representatives to ASEAN (CPR) and the National Coordinators of the Pacific Alliance was convened on 5 August 2026 at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat, in hybrid format. The Meeting exchanged views on developments in both regions, reviewed the implementation of the ASEAN-Pacific Alliance Work Plan 2021-2026, and reaffirmed the shared commitment to further strengthening cooperation for mutual benefit. The Meeting was attended by the CPR, National Coordinators of the Pacific Alliance, the Deputy Secretary-General of ASEAN for ASEAN Political-Security Community, and the Ambassadors and representatives of the Embassies of the Pacific Alliance Member Countries in Jakarta.

The world's first 16-megawatt tension-leg floating wind turbine – the "Haiyou Anlan," built by China National Offshore Oil Corporation – has officially been connected to the Lufeng oilfield grid in the South China Sea, delivering green electricity directly to offshore oil operations. #ChinaSeen Why it matters: Traditional fixed-bottom wind turbines are limited to waters shallower than 50 meters. But the vast majority of the world's offshore wind resources actually lie in deep water – beyond 60 meters – where fixed foundations become economically unviable due to soaring costs and technical complexity. Floating wind is the only technology that can unlock these deepwater resources. The "Haiyou Anlan," installed at a water depth of 136 meters and 136 kilometers off the coast, proves that China can now tap into this enormous potential. Once fully operational, the "Haiyou Anlan" is expected to generate 54 million kilowatt-hours of green electricity annually, saving 15,000 cubic meters of fuel oil and reducing 35,000 tons of CO₂ emissions.

O texto partiu de uma Medida Provisória enviada por nosso Governo ao Congresso. On January 15, 2025, Falcon 9 successfully deployed Firefly Aerospace’s Blue Ghost Mission 1 and ispace’s RESILIENCE lunar landers on a trajectory to the Moon from pad 39A in Florida. For most of our missions, we plan a controlled deorbit of the Falcon second stage so it safely reenters over the ocean. For higher energy missions like those to a lunar transfer orbit, nearly all performance on the vehicle is devoted to successfully placing the payload in the intended orbit, and a controlled disposal maneuver is not always possible. We actively work to be as responsible as possible with hardware left in space to ensure space safety, including for more complex missions. In this case, over time, solar activity and gravity led the second stage toward the Moon. Impacts like this are rare, but they can happen with objects in these types of orbits, and we worked with NASA on the optimal disposal solution. Our focus remains on advancing reliable access to space while working toward even more sustainable operations with Starship in the future. As a fully reusable vehicle, Starship is designed to eliminate expendable upper stages entirely, reducing hardware left in orbit and enabling even more missions to the Moon, Mars, and beyond.

Excuse me, what? The same Carbyne that Jeffrey Epstein helped Ehud Barak sell in Mongolia?! Hedgie (@HedgieMarkets) 🦔New Orleans is now using AI to answer 911 calls. Orleans Parish Communication District rolled out Carbyne's AI Emergency Call Triage last week, which routes callers to an AI agent that asks if they are calling about an ongoing incident. If yes, the AI handles it. If no, the call goes to a human. The city processes over 1,000 emergency calls a day. New Orleans has been using AI to answer 311 non-emergency calls since April. My Take Municipal budgets are a new customer segment for AI vendors. Cities are cash-strapped, headcount is expensive, and AI triage systems cost a fraction of adding dispatchers. Carbyne is one of several companies selling into 911 call centers, and the sales pitch focuses on cost per call and staff efficiency. The pitch works for city CFOs, and the technology may work well for the routine cases it is designed to handle. The unresolved question is what happens when the AI misclassifies an emergency as a non-emergency, or when it fails to understand a caller with a heavy accent or panicked speech pattern. Speech recognition accuracy in controlled testing conditions does not always transfer to the conditions of an actual 911 call. Cities that adopt this technology now will run a live experiment on their residents before the failure data comes in. The vendors are moving fast because municipal contracts are a growing revenue line and every city that signs up becomes a reference customer for the next one. Going into a currency market and intervening requires you to basically sell some other currency. So, in the case of the Japanese, it's usually the U.S. dollar because that's what most of their foreign holdings are denominated in. That pushes the yen up versus the U.S. dollar, which is something that the Trump administration, and most American administrations, really don't care about because these are structural factors. You would have to intervene over and over again to have a meaningful impact on something that's being driven by overwhelming macroeconomic forces. If you're a weaker or less-developed country, it's easy to push your currency down because you just print more currency, dump it on the market, and the value of your currency tanks. Some countries in the past, Japan included, have done that to encourage exports. That's not what's in play here. This is a situation where the yen is so weak that it's starting to affect Japan's import bill, especially in light of the Iran and Ukraine wars. With energy imports becoming more and more expensive, and those imports all denominated in U.S. dollars, you can see why they would want a somewhat stronger currency. For this to stick, they're going to have to do it over and over and over again. #yen #usdollar #usd #economics #geopolitics

মুক্তিযুদ্ধ বিষয়ক মন্ত্রণালয় আয়োজিত ‘জুলাই শহীদ পরিবার ও জুলাই যোদ্ধাদের সংবর্ধনা ও আলোচনা সভায় প্রদর্শিত তথ্যচিত্রে জুলাই গণঅভ্যুত্থানের কিছু গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ঘটনাপ্রবাহ ও অবদান যথাযথভাবে উপস্থাপিত না হওয়ায় যে অনাকাঙ্ক্ষিত পরিস্থিতির সৃষ্টি হয়েছে, সে জন্য মুক্তিযুদ্ধ বিষয়ক মন্ত্রণালয়ের মাননীয় মন্ত্রী ও মাননীয় প্রতিমন্ত্রী আন্তরিকভাবে দুঃখ প্রকাশ করেছেন। গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশের মহামান্য রাষ্ট্রপতির উপস্থিতিতে অনুষ্ঠানে বিষয়টি উত্থাপিত হওয়ার সঙ্গে সঙ্গেই মুক্তিযুদ্ধ বিষয়ক মন্ত্রণালয়ের মাননীয় মন্ত্রী উপস্থিত অতিথিবৃন্দের উদ্দেশ্যে আন্তরিক দুঃখ প্রকাশ করেন এবং তথ্যচিত্রে কোনো ধরনের ত্রুটি বা অসম্পূর্ণতা থেকে থাকলে তা দ্রুত সংশোধনের আশ্বাস দেন। একই সঙ্গে মাননীয় প্রতিমন্ত্রীও এ অনিচ্ছাকৃত ত্রুটির জন্য আন্তরিক দুঃখ প্রকাশ করেছেন। মন্ত্রণালয়ের পক্ষ থেকে পুনরায় জানানো হচ্ছে যে, জুলাই গণঅভ্যুত্থানের ইতিহাসের যথার্থতা ও পূর্ণাঙ্গতা নিশ্চিত করতে সংশ্লিষ্ট সকলের মতামতের ভিত্তিতে তথ্যচিত্রটি সংশোধন করে শিগগিরই পুনরায় জনসম্মুখে উন্মুক্ত করা হবে। প্রদর্শিত তথ্যচিত্রে জুলাই আন্দোলনের ধারাবাহিকতার কয়েকটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অধ্যায়, বিশেষ করে বৈষম্যবিরোধী ছাত্র আন্দোলনের ভূমিকা, ৯ দফা কর্মসূচি, ৩ আগস্ট ঘোষিত এক দফা এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট ঐতিহাসিক ঘটনাবলির যথাযথ প্রতিফলন না হওয়া ছিল সম্পূর্ণ অনিচ্ছাকৃত। কোনো ব্যক্তি, সংগঠন বা গণঅভ্যুত্থানে অবদান রাখা কোনো পক্ষের ভূমিকা খাটো করা, উপেক্ষা করা বা ইতিহাসের কোনো অংশকে আড়াল করার কোনো উদ্দেশ্য মন্ত্রণালয়ের ছিল না এবং নেই। মুক্তিযুদ্ধবিষয়ক মন্ত্রণালয় জুলাই গণঅভ্যুত্থানের ইতিহাসকে নির্ভুল, অন্তর্ভুক্তিমূলক ও তথ্যভিত্তিকভাবে সংরক্ষণে অঙ্গীকারাবদ্ধ। এ লক্ষ্যে সংশ্লিষ্ট বিশেষজ্ঞ, গবেষক এবং আন্দোলনের প্রতিনিধিদের মতামত গ্রহণ করে তথ্যচিত্রটি প্রয়োজনীয় সংশোধন ও পরিমার্জনের উদ্যোগ ইতোমধ্যে গ্রহণ করা হয়েছে। সংশোধিত তথ্যচিত্র দ্রুত পুনরায় জনসমক্ষে উন্মুক্ত করা হবে, যাতে জুলাই গণঅভ্যুত্থানের প্রকৃত ইতিহাস, ঘটনাপ্রবাহ, সংশ্লিষ্ট সকলের গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অবদান, যথাযথ মর্যাদা ও ঐতিহাসিক সত্যতা নিষ্ঠার সঙ্গে উপস্থাপিত হয়। মুক্তিযুদ্ধ বিষয়ক মন্ত্রণালয় এ ঘটনায় সৃষ্ট অনাকাঙ্ক্ষিত পরিস্থিতির জন্য আবারও আন্তরিক দুঃখ প্রকাশ করছে এবং জুলাই গণঅভ্যুত্থানের ইতিহাস সংরক্ষণে সকলের গঠনমূলক মতামত, সহযোগিতা ও সহমর্মিতা কামনা করছে। সত্যনিষ্ঠ, নিরপেক্ষ ও অন্তর্ভুক্তিমূলক ইতিহাস সংরক্ষণই মন্ত্রণালয়ের অঙ্গীকার। #Bangladesh Statement on the restoration of full Statehood to Jammu & Kashmir Seven years after the abrogation of Article 370 and the bifurcation of the erstwhile state, the people of Jammu & Kashmir are still waiting for the restoration of full statehood. The prime minister and the union home Minister have repeatedly assured the nation that statehood would be restored, yet those assurances remain unfulfilled. Delimitation has been completed. Elections have been held. Yet, Jammu & Kashmir continues under a constitutional arrangement where an unelected lieutenant governor exercises overriding authority over matters that should rest with an elected government. This departs from the federal principles of our constitution and denies the people the full measure of democratic self-governance enjoyed by every other state. كما ناقش الوزراء، الجهود المبذولة لخفض التصعيد ومعالجة التحديات الأمنية الراهنة، وضرورة مواصلة دعم الحلول الدبلوماسية، وجهود الوساطة الباكستانية القطرية، وتعزيز كل ما من شأنه احترام سيادة الدول وسلامة أراضيها، بما يحفظ أمن المنطقة واستقرارها.

وأكد الوزراء على أهمية تكاتف الجهود لضمان سلامة الممرات المائية في مضيقي هرمز وباب المندب، بما يضمن حرية الملاحة البحرية فيهما، ويسهم في الحفاظ على استقرار سلاسل الإمداد وأسواق الطاقة، مثمنين مبادرة المملكة العربية السعودية في إنشاء التحالف البحري الدفاعي متعدد الجنسيات لتعزيز الأمن البحري وحماية الممرات البحرية الدولية، والتصدي للتهديدات التي تستهدف الملاحة والتجارة الدوليتين.
وخلال الاجتماع، بحث سمو الوزير مع نظرائه أصحاب المعالي الوزراء مستجدات الأوضاع الإقليمية، وأهمية مواصلة الجهود وتكثيف التنسيق المشترك، وتوحيد المواقف بشأن القضايا الإقليمية الراهنة.

【買取業務に関するご報告とお詫び】 本日、当店にて買取をご利用いただいたお客様より、「提出したカードが足りない」とのご指摘をいただきました。お客様は7枚提出されたとお申し出いただきましたが、当店側では当時5枚しか確認できず、査定担当者も「そのカードは見ていない」と回答いたしました。 その後、受付担当が防犯カメラの映像確認を提案し、査定担当者が該当の映像を確認。映っていた場面を写真で撮影し、お客様に提示いたしましたが、その映像には5枚しか映っていないように見えました。 その時点で受付担当は「映像で5枚しか確認できないため、納得いただけない場合は警察を呼んでご確認いただいた方が良いのでは」とお伝えしました。この発言はお客様への不信を前提としたものではありませんでしたが、結果として高圧的に受け取られかねないものであり、深く反省しております。 一度はお客様より「納得した」とのお言葉をいただきましたが、その数時間後「やはり足りないので再確認してほしい」とのご連絡をいただきました。PSAの鑑定番号も添えていただき、改めてより広い範囲の映像を確認したところ、お客様が査定物を出す準備の段階において、確かに7枚のカードをお出しになっていたことが確認されました。 結果として、査定担当者が7枚中5枚のみを査定し、残りの2枚を誤って査定済み用のケースに収納していたことが原因であったことが判明しました。このミスにより、お客様に不信感とご迷惑をおかけしてしまったことを、深くお詫び申し上げます。 今回の件では以下のような点が、お客様の信頼を損なう結果につながってしまいました： ①防犯映像が5枚に見えたという理由のみで、お客様のご申告を否定してしまったこと （映像には角度や映り方による限界があり、確定的な判断材料とすべきではありませんでした） ②「警察を呼びますか」といった対応が、誠実さではなく威圧と受け取られるような表現になってしまったこと ③映像確認の範囲が不十分で、カード提出の準備段階を確認していなかったこと （結果として「十分に確認もしていないのに、否定された」と感じさせてしまった可能性があります） お客様の大切なお品物をお預かりする立場として、あるまじき対応だったと真摯に受け止めております。 今後は以下のような再発防止策を徹底し、同様のことが起こらぬよう努めてまいります。 ・査定時のカード枚数を受付・査定・返却の各段階で必ず記録・照合 ・映像確認は受付〜準備段階〜査定開始までを通して行うことを明文化 このたびは、お客様に多大なご不快とご心配をおかけし、誠に申し訳ございませんでした。 今後とも誠実な対応と改善に努めてまいります。

⚓️ On August 4, 2026, a solemn departure ceremony was held in Murmansk to mark the launch of the seventh international Icebreaker of Knowledge expedition to the Arctic, bringing together talented students from around the world. 🇮🇩 Indonesia is represented in the expedition by Galen Athaya, the winner of the national selection. 💬 Galen Athaya: I never imagined that one day I would have the opportunity to travel to such a remote and extraordinary place as the North Pole. Above all, I feel deeply grateful - for this unique opportunity, for the chance to represent Indonesia, and to become part of such an international expedition. I look forward to the journey with great respect and excitement, and I hope it will bring not only new knowledge, but also inspiring encounters, unforgettable experiences, and new perspectives on the future. 📋 The total duration of expedition will be 10 days. After leaving the port, the nuclear-powered icebreaker 50 Let Pobedy will sail across the Barents Sea to the high latitudes of the Arctic, proceed to the Franz Josef Land archipelago, reach the geographic North Pole, and then return to Murmansk. During the voyage, participants will explore the nature of the Far North, observe the operation of a nuclear-powered icebreaker, and learn more about the role of nuclear technology in the development of Arctic shipping. The students will bring their countries’ flags to the North Pole, making the moment of reaching the 90° mark particularly symbolic. 🌐 This year, about 5,000 students from 22 countries competed in the international selection process to participate in the voyage: Armenia, Bangladesh, Belarus, Bolivia, Brazil, Hungary, Vietnam, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, China, Kyrgyzstan, Mongolia, Myanmar, Namibia, Rwanda, Serbia, Tanzania, Turkey, Uzbekistan, and South Africa. 👉 The scientific and educational project Icebreaker of Knowledge is organized with the support of Rosatom. It is aimed at promoting natural science disciplines and technologies of the nuclear industry, finding and supporting talented and gifted children, developing their abilities and offering career guidance. The project brings together school students and students of secondary vocational education programs aged 14-16 from around the world. The top performers join a scientific and educational expedition to the North Pole aboard the nuclear icebreaker 50 Let Pobedy.

These numbers are completly made up and far from the reality I mapped around 40 to 50% of monthly reported airstrikes since march 2026. So, I have clear estimations relying on real data. Nowadays, around 1 KAB out of two is falling in an open terrain (a field), depending on the direction. On some directions, the "precision" is 10% (meaning all other KABs missed their potential target), while on some directions, we reach 80 to 90% precision. From these, I believe 10 to 20% of the KABs (which are hitting something) are really falling on a real target. I've seen example of 50 KABs on a single treeline or 200 on a single forest. There is no way there are 50 positions in a treeline, there are maximum 3, and most are not occupied. When falling on cities, KABs can destroy buildings, but soldiers are most of the time in the basements, so unless the buildings collapse (not often on soviet buildings), they remain unharmed. With the 50% precision (falling on a treeline, a forest, a city, a village...), 10% of those may in fact hit a position. This means we can estimate around 5% of all KABs are really hitting something, which does not mean there are soldiers inside and which does not mean the soldiers are harmed. Thus, we can estimate that up to 450 KABs are indeed falling on real positions every month (based on July), while at least 1 000 more fall nearby (cities, field, other part of the treeline and can also kill our wound soldiers. We already know drones are doing the highest number of casualties, making up some numbers with KABs is not reliable. Don't mistaken me, I'm not saying there are no casualties from KABs, this is one of the most important problem right now for Ukraine. We can estimate up to 2 000 casualties every month because of those, including dead and wounded. Also, there is a big difference between KAB 250 and KAB 1 500, as well as between a strike 5km to the frontline and one 20km. PRESS RELEASE Family Expresses Gratitude To All Who Participated in Buhari’s Burial and Prayers The most senior member of the Buhari family, the family of the late President, Muhammadu Buhari, Malam Mamman Daura has, on behalf of the family expressed gratitude to President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and his wife, the First Lady, Senator Remi Tinubu for their role and that of Government of the Federation before, and after the passing of the former president. “It is truly comforting to receive such support from the President and the Vice President, Kashim Shettima, who went to the United Kingdom, and here in Daura, for the days he and the ministers during the mourning period. These have instilled confidence in all of us to face this loss with courage. “We are deeply grateful to the President on his thoughtful gestures in declaring a public holiday and renaming the University of Maiduguri after Buhari. “Our gratitude also goes to leaders of the various countries around the globe who either came in person, sent representatives, sent letters, or placed personal telephone calls to commiserate with us. Of special note were those of the King of England, King Charles III, the Secretary General of the United Nations, the Deputy Secretary General, Amina Mohammed, the Chairman of the African Union, and that of the Committee of Heads of State and Government of ECOWAS countries, and our former Head of State, Abdulsalami Abubakar. “Muhammadu Buhari’s demise is an irreparable loss and its pain is beyond words, but the general reaction and kind expressions give us the strength to cope with the loss of our esteemed family member and former leader of the country. “The family is equally grateful to Vice President Kashim Shettima in his own person and his wife, and to all state governors, especially those of Katsina, the host governor Dr Dikko Umar Radda; Professor Babagana Umara Zulum of Borno State and all those who visited us in the UK and Daura from Adamawa, Kano, Kwara, Lagos, Kaduna, Imo, Nasarawa, Bauchi, Sokoto, Kebbi as well as the several former governors, including Dr Peter Obi for their compassionate words of condolence. Your empathy has touched our hearts deeply, and we are truly grateful for your kindness. "We express our deep appreciations to former Vice Presidents Atiku Abubakar, Architect Namadi Sambo, Professor Yemi Osinbajo, and Ambassador Babagana Kingibe as well as to the President of Senate, Godswill Akpabio, the Speaker, House of Representatives, Honorable Tajuddeen Abbas, Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin and the other leaders and members of the National and State Assemblies. “We do sincerely thank the Secretary to the Government of the Federation, SGF, Senator George Akume and his predecessor in office, Boss Mustapha, the current Chief of Staff, Honorable Femi Gbajabiamila and his predecessor, Professor Ibrahim Gambari, former and serving members of the cabinet in both administrations for their activities in these events and their comforting words. “We are very pleased with the amazing gestures of our traditional leaders, notably the Sultan of Sokoto, the Shehu of Borno, the Emir of Gwandu and the host emirs of Katsina and Daura, as well as the various emirs and chiefs from all over Nigeria and the neighboring countries who came in person or sent representatives. “We have been honored by the large turnout of religious leaders, Islamic, Christian and of other faiths, community leaders, women, youth and politicians of various leanings whose surge in Daura was both challenging and reassuring. “The family in Daura is also thanking past and serving security and intelligence, police and military leaders, permanent secretaries, and the rank and file civil servants, community groups and associations, civil society, and the media of communications. 1/2

In the first half of 2026, Ukraine received three times fewer air defense missiles compared to the previous year, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said following a meeting with military leaders. Supplies of anti-ballistic missiles have decreased, even though Ukraine’s partners have them available, Zelenskyy noted. Volodymyr Zelenskyy / Володимир Зеленський (@ZelenskyyUa) I held a meeting with our military, the Ministry of Defense, and the teams of the Security Service of Ukraine, the Defense Intelligence of Ukraine, and the Office. First, the report from Mykhailo Drapatyi, Ihor Skybiuk, and Yevhenii Khmara on the situation at the front and key supply needs. The greatest attention right now is, of course, paid to Kostiantynivka and Slovyansk. Mykhailo briefed on the numbers and capabilities of the units deployed in this sector, the key objectives, and the tasks being carried out. Yevhenii Khmara outlined the drone and funding needs that must be met immediately. We determined which of our active measures will be implemented in the Donetsk region and in several other sectors of the front. I am grateful to all units for their resilience. We also discussed personnel matters in the Armed Forces of Ukraine. Second, we determined the sequence of additional steps to protect infrastructure facilities in Ukraine. Unfortunately, supplies of anti-ballistic capabilities from partners have decreased significantly this year. The number of air defense missiles supplied has dropped threefold compared with 2025. And this concerns not only this summer period, but every period of the first half of 2026. Our partners do have the missiles. It is important that the necessary political decisions on supplies and the acceleration of production processes are ultimately made – including decisions on localization in Ukraine. This is something that can tangibly support not only our country, but also to the global protection of life. Today, there was also a report from Prime Minister of Ukraine Sergii Koretskyi. Together with representatives of Ukrainian businesses, the Prime Minister will propose measures to support business and logistics in Ukraine. Third, we discussed in detail with the military, intelligence, and special services our priorities for August regarding long-range sanctions against Russia for this war. Operations targeting Russian oil facilities and refining are ongoing. The cost to the aggressor of prolonging the war will continue to rise. It is important that our partners’ sanctions against Russia reinforce the impact of our long-range capabilities. We will discuss this with key countries. There are additional measures worth implementing in sanctions policy. Thank you to everyone who is helping! — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/ZelenskyyUa/status/2084943341012021556#m

Christopher Miller (@ChristopherJM) Olha Stefanishyna, @StefanishynaO, has resigned from her post as Ukraine’s ambassador to the US. Her statement: “Today I have decided to resign as Ambassador of Ukraine to the United States of America. This is my own decision, dictated by the personal circumstances discussed earlier. Representing Ukraine in Washington at a time when it is waging a war for its existence has been the greatest honor in my life. As it was an honor to open Ukraine’s path to the European Union as Vice Prime Minister for European and Euro-Atlantic Integration, to promote reforms in the justice sector as Minister of Justice.
