اسلام آباد: 5 اگست 2026۔ وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف سے اسلامی جمہوریہ ایران کے وزیر صنعت، کان کنی و تجارت سید محمد اتابک کی سربراہی میں 6 رکنی وفد کی اسلام آباد میں ملاقات ہوئی. گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ پاکستان اپنے بہترین ہمسایہ برادر ملک اسلامی جمہوریہ ایران کے ساتھ تعلقات کو انتہائی قدر کی نگاہ سے دیکھتا ہے. پاکستان خطے میں امن کے لیے اپنی مخلصانہ کوششیں جاری رکھے گا. خطے میں پائیدار امن کے قیام اور پاکستان اور ایران کے دو طرفہ تعلقات بالخصوص تجارت کے مزید فروغ کے حوالے سے ایرانی صدر عزت مآب ڈاکٹر مسعود پزیشکیان سے حال ہی میں اچھی گفتگو ہوئی. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ امید ہے کہ مسلسل کوششوں سے دونوں ممالک کی قیادت کی جانب سے مقرر کردہ 10 ارب ڈالر کی دوطرفہ تجارت کا ہدف حاصل کیا جائے گا. تجارت، بالخصوص خوراک اور زرعی اجناس و مصنوعات کی تجارت کے فروغ سے دونوں ممالک مستفید ہوں گے. ملاقات میں پاکستان اور ایران کا سرحدی تجارت کے فروغ اور 24 گھنٹے بارڈر کھلا رکھنے کے لیے سہولیات بڑھانے، بہتر لاجسٹکس اور کسٹمز طریقہ کار میں ہم آہنگی لانے اور دونوں ممالک کے درمیان کان کنی کے شعبے، خصوصاً قیمتی پتھروں کی پراسیسنگ اور ویلیو ایڈیشن میں تعاون بڑھانے پر اتفاق ہوا. وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے ایران کے سپریم لیڈر آیت اللہ سید مجتبیٰ حسینی خامنہ ای اور صدر ڈاکٹر مسعود پزشکیان کے لیے نیک تمناؤں کا پیغام دیا. ایرانی وزیر سید محمد اتابک نے کہا کہ پرتپاک استقبال اور شاندار میزبانی پر پاکستان کے شکر گزار ہیں. خطے میں امن کے لیے پاکستان کی مخلصانہ سفارتی کوششوں اور ایران کے ساتھ اظہارِ یکجہتی پر پاکستانی قیادت اور عوام کو خراجِ تحسین پیش کرتے ہیں.ایران پاکستان کے ساتھ اقتصادی اور تجارتی تعلقات کو مزید وسعت دینے کا خواہاں ہے. پاکستان اور ایران کے درمیان آزاد تجارتی معاہدے (Free Trade Agreement) کے حوالے سے تکنیکی سطح پر مذاکرات جاری ہیں. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء رانا تنویر حسین، جام کمال خان، علی پرویز ملک، جنید انور چوہدری، وزیر مملکت برائے خزانہ بلال اظہر کیانی، معاونین خصوصی سید طارق فاطمی، ہارون اختر اور طلحہ برکی اور متعلقہ اداروں کے اعلیٰ افسران شریک تھے۔ Video

On the occasion of the 72nd Foundation Day of @LalitKalaLKA, under the aegis of the Ministry of Culture, an event was organised today at Ravindra Bhawan, Delhi, to commemorate over seven decades of its contribution to promoting visual art in India. The occasion was graced by Shri KK Mishra (@KKMtweet), Joint Secretary, Ministry of Culture. He launched two publications, Chitra Kanu Desai & Kalaguru Ravishankar Raval, authored by Shri Kanaiyalal Fakirchand Patel. Also present on the occasion were officials and dignitaries from the ministry, including Shri Rajeev Kumar, Director, and Shri Aneish Rajan, Director. The celebration also featured cultural performances and live art demonstrations, highlighting Lalit Kala Akademi's enduring contribution to India's artistic heritage. #CultureUnitesAll

A tourism enterprise's journey extends far beyond construction. It involves multiple approvals, licences, and compliance requirements that shape its progress from concept to operation. NITI Aayog's report, Unlocking Growth in Tourism and Hospitality Sector , recommends a range of measures to simplify this journey, including integrated departmental NOCs, automated building-plan scrutiny, a single Health Trade Licence for hotel services, and a unified liquor licence across service areas within the same premises. By streamlining regulatory processes, the recommendations aim to accelerate project execution, reduce compliance costs, and strengthen investor confidence, fostering a more efficient and competitive tourism ecosystem. औद्योगिक विस्तारासाठी भूसंपादन गतिमान, गुंतवणुकीला मिळणार चालना! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज वर्षा निवासस्थान, मुंबई येथे महाराष्ट्र औद्योगिक विकास महामंडळाअंतर्गत (MIDC) विविध प्रकल्पांच्या भूसंपादनासंदर्भात आढावा बैठक पार पडली. राज्यामध्ये नवीन औद्योगिक वसाहतींचा विस्तार वेगाने होत आहे. या विस्तारातूनच औद्योगिक विकास होणार आहे. त्यामुळे उद्योगांना आवश्यक जमीन वेळेत उपलब्ध करून देणे गरजेचे आहे. भूसंपादनाची प्रक्रिया गतिमान करून महाराष्ट्रातील औद्योगिक विकासाला चालना द्यावी, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, औद्योगिक भूखंड वाटप प्रक्रिया अधिक पारदर्शक करण्यासाठी ‘मिलाप’ या ऑनलाइन प्रणालीद्वारे अर्ज, रिअल-टाईम ट्रॅकिंग, ऑफर लेटर आणि वाटप आदेशांचे स्वयंचलित वितरण, तसेच डॅशबोर्ड सुविधा उपलब्ध करून देण्यात आल्या आहेत. 1 ऑक्टोबर 2025 ते 31 जुलै 2026 या कालावधीत राज्यात 1183 औद्योगिक भूखंडांचे वाटप करण्यात आले आहे. त्यातून ₹5502 कोटींचा महसूल प्राप्त झाला आहे. राज्यात सध्या 66,343 एकर जमीन संपादनाची प्रक्रिया सुरू आहे. गडचिरोली, चंद्रपूर, नागपूर, पुणे, पालघर, छत्रपती संभाजीनगर, ठाणे, रत्नागिरी, रायगड, नाशिक आणि वर्धा या जिल्ह्यांमध्ये ही प्रक्रिया सुरू आहे. राज्यातील 97 सामंजस्य करारांतर्गत सुमारे 75,234 एकर जमिनीची मागणी आहे. त्यासाठी आवश्यक कार्यवाही सुरू आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. उच्चाधिकार समिती स्तरावरील मंजुरी, विविध प्रशासकीय टप्पे आणि वनविषयक परवानग्यांमुळे होणारा विलंब कमी करण्यासाठी प्रक्रिया अधिक सुलभ करावी. उद्योगांना आवश्यक जमीन वेळेत उपलब्ध व्हावी आणि गुंतवणूक प्रकल्पांना गती मिळावी, यासाठी अनावश्यक प्रशासकीय टप्पे कमी करण्यावर भर देण्यात यावा, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, प्रकल्पाचे स्वरूप आणि गुंतवणुकीच्या प्रमाणानुसार भूखंड विकासासाठी निश्चित कालमर्यादा ठरवण्यात यावी. निर्धारित मुदतीत बांधकाम सुरू करणे बंधनकारक राहणार असून, विकासात विलंब झाल्यास टप्प्याटप्प्याने दंड आकारणे, तसेच आवश्यकतेनुसार भूखंड पुन्हा ताब्यात घेण्याची तरतूदही प्रस्तावित करावी. औद्योगिक जमिनीच्या वापरात सुसूत्रता आणि कार्यक्षमता आणण्यासाठी देश-विदेशातील सर्वोत्तम पद्धती आणि इतर राज्यांतील धोरणांचा अभ्यास करून नवीन जमीन वाटपाचे निकष निश्चित करावेत, असेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. यावेळी औद्योगिक भूखंड वाटप, अविकसित भूखंडांचे पुनर्विकसन, भूखंड वाटपातील धोरणात्मक सुधारणा, भूखंडांचे तर्कसंगतीकरण तसेच औद्योगिक प्रकल्पांसाठी जमीन संपादनाच्या कामांचा आढावा घेण्यात आला. ‘एमआयडीसी’च्या वतीने विविध ठिकाणी सुरू असलेल्या भूसंपादनाच्या सद्यस्थितीबाबत सादरीकरणाद्वारे यावेळी माहिती देण्यात आली. यावेळी वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @midc_india #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #Mumbai

محمدنبی خلیلی، مالک شهر «امید سبز» در غرب کابل که از سوی طالبان «امارتی» اعلام شده و به باشندگان آن دستور تخلیه داده شده است، خواستار «بازنگری مجدد و بررسی دقیق حقوقی» تصمیم محکمه‌ی اختصاصی طالبان در مورد این شهرک شده است. آقای خلیلی در اعلامیه‌ای که امروز (چهارشنبه، ۱۴ اسد) در فیس‌بوک منتشر کرده، نوشته است: «شهرک امید سبز بر پایه قباله‌های شرعی معتبر، اسناد رسمی مالکیت، تصفیه کامل از ادارات ذی‌صلاح و جواز قانونی اعمار ایجاد گردیده است.» او افزوده است: «تمامی مراحل ایجاد این شهرک با هدف رعایت قانون و احترام به حقوق مالکیت انجام شده و هزاران خانواده با اعتماد به اعتبار این اسناد، سرمایه زندگی خود را صرف تهیه سرپناه کرده‌اند.» بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258561

شهرک امید سبز، در نهایت، حداکثر می‌تواند مصداق «احیای موات» باشد؛ آن هم در حالی که با مجوز رسمی وزارت مسکن و شهرسازی احداث شده است. بنابراین، حتا براساس دیدگاه سخت‌گیرانه‌ی فقه حنفی که اخذ اجازه‌ی امام یا حاکم را برای احیای موات لازم می‌داند، این شرط تحقق یافته است. افزون بر این، مطابق نظر سه مذهب دیگر اهل سنت، همچنین دیدگاه ابویوسف قاضی و شماری از فقهای حنفی، اساسا اخذ اجازه‌ی امام برای احیای موات شرط نیست. بیشتر در لینک زیر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258556

تیم ملی فوتسال افغانستان در سومین بازی خود در جام کانتیننتال، به مصاف روسیه رفت و به تساوی سه‌برسه دست یافت. این بازی ساعت ۳:۳۰ دقیقه‌ی پس‌ازچاشت امروز (چهارشنبه، ۱۴ اسد) در تایلند آغاز شد و لحظات پیش به پایان رسید. روس‌ها در دقیقه‌ی هفتم بازی توانستند اولین گل را به ثمر برسانند و پیش بیفتند، اما درست یک دقیقه بعد، اکبر کاظمی گل تساوی افغانستان را به ثمر رساند و نیمه‌ی اول با همین نتیجه به پایان رسید. در نیمه‌ی دوم نیز ابتدا روسیه گل دوم خود را به ثمر رساند، اما در ادامه بازیکنان افغانستان با به ثمر رساندن دو گل پیش افتادند، ولی در لحظات پایانی بازیکنان روسیه گل سوم را به ثمر رساندند و بازی به تساوی کشیده شد. با این تساوی افغانستان یک‌امتیازی شد و روسیه پنج‌امتیازی. افغانستان در دو بازی قبلی خود شش بر یک از تایلند و دو بر یک از ویتنام شکست خورده بود.

Trump Gives Green Light to Saudi Nuclear Program The Donald Trump administration has finalized the draft of a bilateral nuclear agreement that authorizes Saudi Arabia to enrich uranium on its own territory. Although the negotiating teams have completed the terms, the document still awaits Trump’s final signature and approval by the U.S. Congress. This framework breaks with the region’s long-standing non-proliferation rules. Unlike the deal with the United Arab Emirates, which permanently renounced uranium enrichment and plutonium reprocessing while accepting strict IAEA inspections, the agreement with the Saudis does not require Riyadh to adopt the Agency’s inspection regime. Oversight will be limited to a bilateral pact between the United States and Saudi Arabia. This reinforces what Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has already said openly: if Iran gets a nuclear weapon, Saudi Arabia will want one too. It sounds like a clear signal that Riyadh believes Tehran already has, or is very close to having, the bomb, which explains the intense pressure they are putting on Washington. The situation puts the U.S. in a complicated position. Saudi Arabia’s ballistic missile program is developed in partnership with China, complete with technology transfers. If the Americans don’t give in now, the Saudis have plenty of money to look for other partners. This is not just about civilian nuclear energy. For that, it would be enough to buy reactors and import ready-made fuel. What Riyadh really wants is to master the full nuclear fuel cycle, especially domestic uranium enrichment. With this infrastructure, Saudi Arabia is building a nuclear latency capability: it will control the core technology needed to develop a weapon in relatively short order if pushed by an existential threat. German authorities are investigating what appears to have been an attempted explosive drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport after a drone carrying an explosive device was discovered near Ukrainian cargo aircraft, according to BILD. BILD reports the drone was found late Tuesday night on the airport apron with an attached package that security authorities identified as containing explosive material after a positive nitrate test. An X-ray reportedly revealed a detonator, but investigators believe it malfunctioned, preventing the device from detonating. The explosive package has been preserved for forensic examination rather than destroyed, and BILD reports NATO investigators are expected to participate in the investigation. The incident occurred near several Ukrainian Antonov cargo aircraft at one of Europe's most important cargo hubs, including shipments supporting Ukraine. Airport operations were temporarily suspended following the discovery. BILD also reports that shortly after the airport was closed, a DHL cargo aircraft aborted its landing and later struck an unidentified object approximately 400 meters above the ground and about six kilometers from the airport. The aircraft landed safely in Hanover, where damage to its nose section was discovered. German authorities have confirmed the collision occurred and are investigating it as a state security matter, though they have not publicly confirmed that the object was a drone or linked it to the explosive device.

1 травня минулого року на замовлення ФСБ в мене стріляли. За кілька років до того на замовлення громадянина РФ Труханова в мене також стріляли. І били та різали. Після третього нападу ще у 2018 році мені із охороною допомагали друзі. Окрема подяка Роману Сініцину, він знає за що. Згодом, коли монетизація з ютубу і дохід з магазину стали дозволяти, я винаймав охорону сам. Коли ж дізнався про підготовку замаху минулого року, коли вже вбили Ірину Фаріон та Демʼяна Ганула, узяв у користування броньоване авто. За що вигрібаю досі, бо ж я мав померти, а не вжити заходів безпеки. Тоді ж мені надали державну охорону. Вперше до нападу, бо у 2018-му її не надавали взагалі, тільки моєму нападнику раз. Зрештою, воїн "Альфи" минулого року врятував мені життя, зупинивши жінку, яка стріляла. Якби не він, зараз був би 1 рік і 3 місяці, як моє тіло лежало б у землі. Тож чому я вживаю усіх можливих заходів безпеки? Загадка! А чому помийку "Труху" та її сітку так цікавить це питання? Чому власників цієї помийки так хвилює та сама тема, що і ФСБ РФ, котра і сьогодні вживає активних заходів щоб мене знайти і підірвати, застрелити чи отруїти. "Труха", як і ФСБ хоче, щоб мене вбили, це очевидно. Тут не може бути іншого пояснення. Дану атаку я сприймаю як частину фізичних нападів на моє життя. Спершу брехня і бруд, тонни фейків і маніпуляцій, тепер посягання на безпеку. Реальні власники "Трухи" (а це не фунт Удянський чи дурачок Лавриненко) мають усвідомлювати, що зараз вони перетнули небезпечну межу. Це не залишиться без відповіді.

انفارمیشن ٹیکنالوجی کے ماہرین شامل کیے جائیں. عالمی معیار کی افرادی قوت اور ماہرین نجکاری کمیشن کی استعداد کار اور اداروں میں سرمایہ کاری بڑھانے کے لیے موثر اقدامات کو یقینی بنائے گی۔ نجکاری کے مراحل ফুটবল ম্যাচ চলাকালেই হঠাৎ আকাশ চিরে ঝলসে উঠলো তীব্র বজ্রের আলো, এরপরই বিকট শব্দে কেঁপে ওঠে পুরো মাঠ। মুহূর্তের মধ্যেই আনন্দ-উচ্ছ্বাসের পরিবেশ বদলে যায় আতঙ্ক আর বিশৃঙ্খলায়। থাইল্যান্ডের দক্ষিণাঞ্চলের সুঙ্গাই গোলক শহরের শান্তিফাপ স্টেডিয়ামে এই মর্মান্তিক ঘটনায় বজ্রপাতে এক ফুটবলারের মৃত্যু হয়েছে। একই ঘটনায় আহত হয়েছেন আরও অন্তত ১২ জন ফুটবলার। মঙ্গলবার (৪ আগস্ট) অনুষ্ঠিত গোলক এফএ কাপের একটি ম্যাচে মুখোমুখি হয়েছিল স্যামকোল্টস ও আবু এক্স নং সিরিন। থাইল্যান্ড ও মালয়েশিয়ার অপেশাদার ফুটবলারদের অংশগ্রহণে আয়োজিত এই ম্যাচ চলাকালেই আবহাওয়ার আকস্মিক অবনতি ঘটে। প্রবল মৌসুমি বৃষ্টির মধ্যে খেলা চলতে থাকলেও একপর্যায়ে বিকট শব্দে মাঠে বজ্রপাত হয়। সামাজিক যোগাযোগমাধ্যমে ছড়িয়ে পড়া ভিডিওতে দেখা যায়, মুহূর্তের জন্য তীব্র আলোর ঝলকানিতে মাঠের একটি অংশ আলোকিত হয়ে ওঠে। এরপরই একে একে কয়েকজন ফুটবলার মাটিতে লুটিয়ে পড়েন, সৃষ্টি হয় চরম আতঙ্ক ও বিশৃঙ্খলা। বজ্রপাতের সবচেয়ে মারাত্মক শিকার হন স্যামকোল্টসের ২৪ বছর বয়সি উইঙ্গার সফওয়ান আওয়ায়ে। ঘটনায় তিনি গুরুতরভাবে দগ্ধ হন। সম্প্রতি থাইল্যান্ডের তৃতীয় বিভাগের পেশাদার ক্লাব ইয়ালা এফসির সঙ্গে চুক্তিবদ্ধ হওয়া এই তরুণ ফুটবলার ওই ম্যাচে স্যামকোল্টসের জার্সিতে খেলছিলেন। বজ্রপাতের পরপরই সতীর্থরা দ্রুত তার কাছে ছুটে যান। মাঠেই তাকে প্রাথমিক চিকিৎসা দেওয়ার পাশাপাশি বুকে চাপ দিয়ে কৃত্রিম শ্বাস-প্রশ্বাসের (সিপিআর) মাধ্যমে প্রাণ ফিরিয়ে আনার চেষ্টা করেন তারা। পরে জরুরি চিকিৎসাসেবায় দলের সদস্যরাও সর্বোচ্চ চেষ্টা চালান। তবে ধরনের চেষ্টা সত্ত্বেও সফওয়ান আওয়ায়েকে আর বাঁচানো সম্ভব হয়নি। স্থানীয় পুলিশের তথ্য অনুযায়ী, আহতদের দ্রুত উদ্ধার করে নিকটস্থ হাসপাতালে ভর্তি করা হয়েছে এবং তাদের চিকিৎসা চলছে। তরুণ এই ফুটবলারের মৃত্যুতে গভীর শোক প্রকাশ করেছে ইয়ালা এফসি। সামাজিক যোগাযোগমাধ্যমে প্রকাশিত এক শোকবার্তায় ক্লাবটি সফওয়ান আওয়ায়ের মৃত্যুতে গভীর দুঃখ প্রকাশ করে তার পরিবারের সদস্যদের প্রতি আন্তরিক সমবেদনা জানিয়েছে। থাইল্যান্ডে বজ্রপাতে প্রাণহানির ঘটনা বিরল নয়। দেশটির রোগ নিয়ন্ত্রণ বিভাগের পরিসংখ্যান অনুযায়ী, ২০২০ থেকে ২০২৪ সালের মধ্যে বজ্রপাতে অন্তত ২৮৩ জন হতাহত হয়েছেন। তাদের মধ্যে উল্লেখযোগ্য সংখ্যক মানুষের ঘটনাস্থলেই মৃত্যু হয়েছে। #football #SportsNews #Sports #somoytv

نخستین دیدار تیم ملی کرکت افغانستان در برابر ایرلند در سلسله مسابقات یک‌روزه بین‌المللی امروز چهارشنبه، پنجم اگست، به دلیل بارندگی و نامساعد بودن وضعیت میدان برگزار نشد. قرار بود این مسابقه ساعت ۲:۱۵ پس از چاشت به وقت افغانستان در میدان کرکت بریدی آغاز شود، اما مسوولان اعلام کردند که به دلیل نامناسب بودن وضعیت میدان در پی بارندگی و احتمال ادامه باران، امکان برگزاری مسابقه وجود ندارد. این دیدار نخستین مسابقه از سلسلۀ پنج بازی پنجاه‌آوره میان دو تیم بود. افغانستان و ایرلند از پنجم تا پانزدهم اگست پنج دیدار یک‌روزه انجام می‌دهند؛ دو مسابقه نخست در بریدی و سه دیدار دیگر در استورمونت برگزار می‌شود. دومین دیدار دو تیم قرار است روز جمعه در میدان بریدی برگزار شود.
دونالد ترمپ، رییس جمهور ایالات متحدۀ امریکا، گفته است که روز سه‌شنبه " تمام روز" با ایران مذاکره انجام شده و به گفتۀ وی "گفتگوهای بسیار خوبی" بوده است. wxyz.page/LOVmm

*India–Nigeria Cooperation in Digital Innovation & Technology* On 4 August 2026, H.E. @AmbAbhishekIFS , High Commissioner of India to Nigeria, met with Ms. Joy Buba, Chief Host of the Technology Ecosystem Dialogue 2026 (TED 2026), accompanied by members of her organizing committee and a delegation of young entrepreneurs and innovators. The delegation invited the High Commissioner to participate in the Organizing Committee for the 4th Edition of the Technology Ecosystem Dialogue 2026 (TED 2026) and Abuja Tech & Digital Economy Week, scheduled to take place from 25–27 November 2026 in Abuja. During the interaction, the High Commissioner highlighted that India is home to one of the world's largest digital economy and is rapidly emerging as a global hub for Artificial Intelligence. Reaffirming India's commitment as a strategic partner of Nigeria, he expressed India's readiness to share its experience and expertise in AI, smart mobility, data protection, digital trade, startup development, and digital public infrastructure to support Nigeria's digital transformation and public service modernization. I held a meeting with our military, the Ministry of Defense, and the teams of the Security Service of Ukraine, the Defense Intelligence of Ukraine, and the Office. First, the report from Mykhailo Drapatyi, Ihor Skybiuk, and Yevhenii Khmara on the situation at the front and key supply needs. The greatest attention right now is, of course, paid to Kostiantynivka and Slovyansk. Mykhailo briefed on the numbers and capabilities of the units deployed in this sector, the key objectives, and the tasks being carried out. Yevhenii Khmara outlined the drone and funding needs that must be met immediately. We determined which of our active measures will be implemented in the Donetsk region and in several other sectors of the front. I am grateful to all units for their resilience. We also discussed personnel matters in the Armed Forces of Ukraine. Second, we determined the sequence of additional steps to protect infrastructure facilities in Ukraine. Unfortunately, supplies of anti-ballistic capabilities from partners have decreased significantly this year. The number of air defense missiles supplied has dropped threefold compared with 2025. And this concerns not only this summer period, but every period of the first half of 2026. Our partners do have the missiles. It is important that the necessary political decisions on supplies and the acceleration of production processes are ultimately made – including decisions on localization in Ukraine. This is something that can tangibly support not only our country, but also to the global protection of life. Today, there was also a report from Prime Minister of Ukraine Sergii Koretskyi. Together with representatives of Ukrainian businesses, the Prime Minister will propose measures to support business and logistics in Ukraine. Third, we discussed in detail with the military, intelligence, and special services our priorities for August regarding long-range sanctions against Russia for this war. Operations targeting Russian oil facilities and refining are ongoing. The cost to the aggressor of prolonging the war will continue to rise. It is important that our partners’ sanctions against Russia reinforce the impact of our long-range capabilities. We will discuss this with key countries. There are additional measures worth implementing in sanctions policy. Thank you to everyone who is helping!

Today, Zelenskyy, Starmer, Macron, and Merz meet in London. The format itself is worth welcoming, even if the EU has once again been left on the sidelines. The real question is what mindset the E3 brings to the table. Zelenskyy set the tone with his open letter to Putin. While his European partners likely share its substance, they are unlikely to be ready to openly put their signatures beneath it. But they do see that Russia is not looking for middle ground. It is set on war. Seeking a balanced compromise with an aggressor committed to conquest is not diplomacy. It is self-deception. The predecessors of today’s leaders understood this well. Symbolically, eighty-five years ago, London hosted another gathering. In June 1941, representatives of fourteen Allied governments and liberation movements met there to unite against Nazism. The final London Declaration was not about ending a war. It was about uniting those willing to win it and shape the peace that followed. One can only hope today’s meeting is guided by the same logic. Europe’s prosperity depends on its security. Europe’s security depends on Ukraine. It is time to turn that truth into effective policy. And fast.

اسلام آباد: 5 اگست 2026۔ وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف سے جاپان انٹرنیشنل کوآپریشن ایجنسی (JICA) کے صدر ڈاکٹر تاناکا آکیہیکو (Dr Tanaka Akihiko ) کی قیادت میں 9 رکنی وفد کی آج اسلام آباد میں ملاقات ہوئی. وفد سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ پاکستان جاپان اور جائیکا کے ساتھ سات دہائیوں پر محیط دیرینہ شراکت داری کو انتہائی قدر کی نگاہ سے دیکھتا ہے. امید ہے کہ جائیکا کے صدر کا دورہ پاکستان دونوں ممالک کے تعلقات کو مزید مضبوط کرے گا. مشکل معاشی چیلنجز پر ٹیم ورک سے قابو پایا، اب پائیدار معاشی ترقی کے لیے اصلاحات کا عمل تیزی سے جاری ہے.حکومتی اصلاحات کے نتیجے میں صرف تین برس میں سرکاری محصولات دگنی ہوئیں. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ نوجوانوں کو ہنر، تکنیکی تربیت اور باعزت روزگار کے مواقع فراہم کرنا اور خواتین کو بااختیار بنانا حکومت کی اولین ترجیح ہے. معدنیات کے شعبے کی ترقی ہماری ترجیحات میں شامل ہے اور اس سلسلے میں JICA کے تکنیکی تعاون کا خیرمقدم کرینگے. چھوٹے اور درمیانے درجے کے کاروبار کی ترقی اور فروغ کے لیے سمیڈا میں اصلاحات کر کے اسے ایک فعال اور مؤثر ادارے بنایا. جائیکا کا سمیڈا کے ساتھ تعاون چھوٹے اور درمیانے درجے کے کاروبار کے فروغ اور برآمدات میں اضافے کیلئے مفید ثابت ہو گا. وزیراعظم نے صدر جائیکا سے جاپان میں حالیہ زلزلے میں قیمتی انسانی جانوں کے نقصان پر اظہار افسوس بھی کیا. ڈاکٹر تاناکا آکیہیکو نے وزیر اعظم کی جانب سے جاپان میں زلزلے سے قیمتی جانوں کے نقصان پر اظہار افسوس پر وزیراعظم کا شکریہ ادا کیا. ڈاکٹر تاناکا نے پاکستان میں انکی شاندار مہمان نوازی پر بھی شکریہ ادا کیا. انہوں نے کہا کہ جائیکا اور پاکستان کی شراکت داری اور تعاون کی ایک طویل تاریخ ہے. جائیکا صحت، تعلیم، شہری و دیہی ترقی، فنی و تکنیکی تربیت اور صنعتی ترقی سمیت مختلف شعبوں میں پاکستان سے تعاون کو مزید وسعت دینے کے لیے تیار ہے. وفاقی اور صوبائی حکومتوں کی ترقیاتی ترجیحات کے مطابق تعاون کو مزید مضبوط بنایا جائے گا. جاپان سمیت عالمی برادری مشرقِ وسطیٰ میں امن کے لیے پاکستان اور اس کی قیادت کی کوششوں کو قدر کی نگاہ سے دیکھتی ہے. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء احسن اقبال، احد خان چیمہ، ڈاکٹر مصدق مسعود ملک، حنیف عباسی، سردار اویس احمد خان لغاری، شزا فاطمہ خواجہ، معاونین خصوصی سید طارق فاطمی اور ہارون اختر اور متعلقہ اداروں کے اعلیٰ افسران شریک تھے۔. Shri Vivek Aggarwal, Secretary, Ministry of Culture and Chair of the BRICS Culture Working Group, delivered the opening remarks at the inaugural session of the 3rd BRICS Culture Working Group Meeting in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. He underscored that the discussions have reaffirmed the shared belief that culture is not merely a repository of the past, but a dynamic force for innovation, resilience, inclusive growth, and deeper people-to-people connections. He also invited the delegates to experience India’s rich civilisational heritage through specially curated exhibitions, a visit to the Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Manav Sangrahalaya (@igrms), tours of the @UNESCO World Heritage Sites of Sanchi and Bhimbetka and the BRICS Cultural Festival at Ravindra Bhawan, where the artistic traditions of BRICS Member and Partner Countries will be celebrated through performances reflecting the diversity and vibrancy of our shared cultural landscape. #CultureUnitesAll #BRICS2026 #BRICSIndia @BricsIndia2026 Video

The 3rd BRICS Culture Working Group Meeting was inaugurated in Bhopal with a ceremonial lamp-lighting, marking the commencement of deliberations under India’s BRICS Chairship. Representatives from BRICS countries delivered their openings remarks on India’s key priorities under the Culture Track, including the creative economy, cultural heritage protection, and culture-led sustainable development. Delegations from Brazil, China, South Africa, UAE, Indonesia, Iran, Russia, and Ethiopia participated in person, while Egypt joined the proceedings in hybrid mode. Ahead of the BRICS Culture Ministers’ Meeting, the Working Group Meeting serves as a significant platform for strengthening cultural cooperation and advancing collaborative initiatives among BRICS nations. #BRICS2026 #CultureUnitesAll @BricsIndia2026

दिल्ली का हर व्यापारी, हर दुकानदार और हर उद्यमी अपने कारोबार के साथ लाखों परिवारों की आजीविका, युवाओं के रोजगार और राजधानी की अर्थव्यवस्था को नई शक्ति देता है। माननीय प्रधानमंत्री श्री @narendramodi के Minimum Government, Maximum Governance के विज़न के अनुरूप, प्रस्तावित दिल्ली ईज ऑफ डूइंग बिजनेस बिल, 2026 के माध्यम से व्यापार को सरल बनाने के लिए कई महत्वपूर्ण सुधार किए जा रहे हैं: 🔹Single Window System से अधिकांश सेवाएं एक ही मंच पर मिलेंगी। 🔹Self Certification से कम जोखिम वाले उद्योगों के लिए अनुपालन आसान होगा। 🔹Deemed Approval से तय समय में निर्णय न होने पर स्वीकृति स्वतः मिलेगी। 🔹नए उद्यमों के लिए 3 वर्षों तक No Routine Inspection होगा। 🔹DSIIDC पूरी प्रक्रिया के लिए Single Nodal Agency होगी। मुख्यमंत्री श्रीमती रेखा गुप्ता के नेतृत्व में दिल्ली सरकार का प्रयास है कि व्यापारियों का समय सरकारी प्रक्रियाओं में नहीं, बल्कि अपने कारोबार के विस्तार में लगे। यह पहल निवेश को प्रोत्साहन देगी, नए उद्योगों को गति देगी और दिल्ली के युवाओं के लिए बड़े पैमाने पर रोजगार के अवसर सृजित करेगी। #ViksitDelhi

Станом на зараз відомо про 44 постраждалих від масованого російського удару по Києву та Київщині. Ще 17 людей, на жаль, загинуло. Мої співчуття рідним та близьким. Важкий був удар: 24 балістичні ракети, 4 «циркони/онікси» та ще 115 дронів, значна частина з них реактивні. Основна ціль атаки – складські приміщення цивільних підприємств, також були удари по інфраструктурі, залізничній станції. Об’єкти, не дотичні до війни: пивоварна компанія, склади будівельних матеріалів, цивільна логістика. Перехоплювачі балістики – те, що могло б зберегти життя загиблих сьогодні. Дуже важливо, щоб партнери усвідомлювали, що затримки з їх постачанням або неготовність передавати антибалістику призводить саме до таких жахливих жертв і руйнувань. Партнери, які не готові допомагати активніше з постачаннями перехоплювачів уже зараз, можуть допомогти новими санкційними кроками. Значна частина російських виробництв балістики не під санкціями. Досі. Потрібні нові кроки від G7 та від ЄС, усіх, хто підтримує захист життя. Дякую тим, хто готовий допомагати саме так.

As of now, 44 people have been reported injured in the massive Russian strike on Kyiv and the Kyiv region. Another 17 people, tragically, were killed. My condolences to their families and loved ones. It was a heavy strike – 24 ballistic missiles, 4 Zircon/Oniks missiles, and another 115 drones, a significant number of them jet-powered. The main targets of the attack were warehouse facilities belonging to civilian businesses. There were also strikes on infrastructure and a railway station. These facilities had nothing to do with the war – a brewing company, construction materials warehouses, and civilian logistics facilities. Ballistic missile interceptors could have saved the lives of those killed today. It is very important that our partners understand that delays in supplying them, or an unwillingness to provide anti-ballistic systems, lead directly to such horrific casualties and destruction. Partners who are not yet ready to play a more active role in supplying interceptors can help by implementing new sanctions. A significant share of Russia’s ballistic missile production is still not under sanctions. Even now. New steps are needed – from the G7, the European Union, and everyone who supports the protection of life. Thank you to those who are willing to help in this way. Video

☦️🇷🇺 On August 4, in Jerusalem, Ambassador of Russia to Israel Anatoly Viktorov took part in the patronal feast of the Gethsemane Convent in honor of Saint Mary Magdalene Equal to the Apostles.The solemn divine liturgy was traditionally attended by Patriarch of the Holy City of Jerusalem and All Palestine Theophilus III and other representatives of the Brotherhood of the Holy Sepulcher of the Jerusalem Orthodox Church. The service was held by Metropolitan Mark (Arndt) of Berlin and Germany. He was co-served by Bishop Job of Stuttgart, head of the Ecclesiastical Mission in Jerusalem of the Russian Orthodox Church Abroad Archimandrite Roman (Krasovsky); head of the Russian Ecclesiastical Mission in Jerusalem of the Moscow Patriarchate Archimandrite Vassian (Zmeev) and clergy from both Missions. Also present were the abbesses and nuns of the Gethsemane and Holy Ascension women’s monasteries, as well as numerous pilgrims. During a friendly conversation with the clergy following the liturgy, Anatoly Viktorov emphasized the importance of strengthening the Russian spiritual presence in the Holy Land, aimed, among other things, at supporting the activity of the Patriarch of Jerusalem in preserving the authentic Christian heritage, caring for Orthodox pilgrims and ensuring the canonical unity of the world Orthodoxy. He provided information on the practical steps taken by the Embassy of Russia in Israel to protect the local Orthodox community from attacks by religious extremists.

1. Former CDS Gen. Anil Chauhan (Retd) was our guest at the latest edition of #OffTheCuff. The conversation, co-hosted by my colleague Snehesh Alex Philip, delved into the need for theatrisation, the biggest surprise of Op. Sindoor, lessons learnt, the future of warfare & why patriotism is not just the Army’s prerogative. Here are some highlights: 2. Gen. Chauhan on his biggest achievement as CDS: “To get the 3 services to talk to each other more often & bring some kind of bonhomie. It existed but not to the degree we wanted. This is essential for any future war… that all of us think together, work together & build mutual confidence…It helped us during Op. Sindoor.” 3. Projects closest to completion? · Gen. Chauhan believes India’s military think tanks should have real autonomy & govt funding so they are not dependent on industry or foreign sources. And, govt has approved the transfer of funds · Include civilian faculty in war colleges · Expansion of capabilities into the geospatial domain · Course on future warfare 4. On the need for theaterisation: There’s a need to separate force generation & force application. Force generation remains the responsibility of current service chiefs, while theatre commanders which are integrated (the 3 services + cyber, space, info warfare, electromagnetic domain) concentrate exclusively on fighting wars. 5. Lessons from Ukraine war & US-Iran conflict: Undoubtedly drones. Ukraine war didn’t introduce drones but it transformed their sophistication & have permanently changed military thinking. Gen. Chauhan says, the next major challenge is missiles. Iran demonstrated that long-range drones & ballistic missiles can penetrate even sophisticated air defences. No country currently possesses a foolproof defence against this threat. 6. Arguing for aircraft carriers vs submarines, Gen. Chauhan says, “Submarines are a good platform. But that doesn’t do away with the requirement of aircraft carriers…It may not be a war-fighting platform, but it is required on a day-to-day basis…. Also, if your presence is there with aircraft carriers in the Indian Ocean Region, a large number of smaller countries on east & west coast get influenced. If you’re not there, this space will be filled up by others. So, this secures a country in the long term.” 7. What were the surprises Op. Sindoor threw up? The “biggest surprise”, says Gen. Chauhan, was when Pakistan picked up the phone on May 10and said it wanted to talk. “Because on the 9th, the kind of rhetoric that was emerging from their side was we’ll sort India out etc & within 8 hours they picked up the phone. We had not executed even half our plans.” 8. Grok 4.5 just turned Blender into a conversation. Instead of manually importing assets, fixing rigs, placing armies, adjusting cameras, and debugging objects that face the wrong direction, the user simply tells Grok what to change. It builds a medieval battlefield from existing 3D assets, adds horses, knights, a castle, siege machines, trees, animation paths, cameras, and even spatial audio. The impressive part is not that it gets everything right. It absolutely does not. Models spawn upside down, characters face the wrong way, and the scene needs constant correction. But Grok keeps editing the actual Blender project instead of generating another fake 3D image and hoping nobody notices. It is replacing a suspicious amount of the boring work they had to do before the skilled part even started. India lists 51 minerals in its critical mineral list. This is 67% of all commercially mined minerals. And globally too, critical mineral lists are swelling. But not all critical minerals are critical in the same way. In any case, if 2/3rds of the periodic table is deemed critical, this strips any nuance for informed policy action and mineral prioritisation. In this episode of All Things Policy, Tannmay Kumarr Baid (@tannmaybaid) and Shobhankita Reddy (@shobhankita), researchers in technology geopolitics at the Takshashila Institution, discuss their latest published work - a mineral-by-mineral analysis of India's 51 critical minerals. They bucket these minerals into six groups, each with a similar mineral profile, shared supply bottlenecks and policy choices for India. Check their dashboard here: indiacriticalminerals.com Video

Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif's Message on Youm-e-Istehsal, 5 August 2026. Today, on Youm-e-Istehsal, the people and the Government of Pakistan stand in unwavering solidarity with our Kashmiri brothers and sisters. We solemnly observe this day to remind the world of the grave consequences of India's illegal and unilateral actions of 5 August 2019, which sought to alter the internationally recognized disputed status of Illegally Indian Occupied Jammu & Kashmir (IIOJK), in flagrant violation of international law and the relevant resolutions of the United Nations Security Council. Seven years on, these unlawful measures have neither changed the legal status of Jammu and Kashmir nor diminished the legitimate aspiration of its people. Instead, they have deepened repression, undermined fundamental freedom, and accelerated attempts to alter the demographic composition of the occupied territory through unlawful legislative and administrative measures. The continued suppression of the genuine Kashmiri political leadership, restrictions on civil liberties, and curbs on independent media, remain a matter of serious concern. Despite these challenges, the courage, resilience and steadfastness of the Kashmiri people remain unshaken. Their peaceful and just struggle for the realization of their unalienable right to self-determination continue to inspire generations and commands the respect and support of all those who believe in justice, human dignity and the rule of international law. The Jammu and Kashmir dispute remains the principal unresolved issue affecting peace and stability in South Asia. Lasting peace in the region cannot be achieved by coercion or unilateral action, but only through a peaceful settlement of the dispute in accordance with the aspirations of the Kashmiri people and the relevant United Nations Security Council resolutions. The international community must move beyond expressions of concern and play its rightful role in advancing a just and durable resolution of the dispute. On this solemn occasion, I reaffirm that peaceful and just resolution of the Jammu & Kashmir dispute remains a cornerstone of Pakistan's foreign policy and Pakistan will continue to extend its diplomatic, political and moral support and raise the voice of the Kashmiri people at every regional and international forum. Pakistan calls upon the international community to urge India to end its human rights violations in IIOJK, reverse its illegal and unilateral measures introduced since August 2019, repeal the draconian laws imposed upon the people of Jammu & Kashmir and create conducive environment to enable the peaceful resolution of the Jammu and Kashmir dispute, through the exercise of the right to self-determination by the Kashmiri people in accordance with the relevant United Nations Security Council resolutions.

Located in Chaoyang, Liaoning province, the Niuheliang site is one of the most important archaeological sites of the late Neolithic Hongshan culture and offers a remarkable glimpse into the early development of Chinese civilization. More than 5,800 years ago, this mountain landscape was home to a grand ceremonial complex of altars, a goddess temple, and stone-built tombs, reflecting a highly organized ritual tradition. Recent discoveries, including large rammed-earth platforms and newly identified ritual features, have further highlighted Niuheliang's role as the core area of an early regional polity. Today, visitors can still sense the spiritual world of a society that revered Heaven, honored its ancestors, and treasured jade, preserving the legacy of one of the origins of Chinese civilization. chinabound.cn Travel with ease in China, and with meaning. #Liaoning #Niuheliang #HongshanCulture #ChinaBound #ASnapshotOfChina

🇸🇦🇦🇪🇺🇸 The Gulf is no longer waiting for Washington to solve its Iran problem. Ian Bremmer’s core argument is straightforward. The U.S. is far less worried about Iranian strikes on its own military bases, most personnel and sensitive equipment have already been moved, than about the soft, high value civilian targets across the Gulf. Saudi oil facilities, desalination plants that supply drinking water, and major airports remain exposed. Those are targets the Gulf states and the U.S. still cannot fully defend. As long as Iran can credibly threaten them, Washington has a strong incentive to avoid any escalation that would invite exactly that kind of retaliation. That restraint gives Tehran lasting leverage over the Strait of Hormuz and the terms of any eventual deal. Yet the Gulf countries themselves are not simply sitting under the old American umbrella and hoping for the best. Saudi has been widening its diplomatic and security network, deeper coordination with Turkey, Pakistan, Egypt, and Qatar, while keeping channels open with Tehran. The UAE has tightened its security partnership with Israel, including air defense cooperation, even while managing its own frictions with Riyadh. Both are pouring money into domestic missile and drone defenses and exploring multipolar options because the war made the limits of exclusive reliance on U.S. protection impossible to ignore. They still need American hard power. But they are actively buying additional insurance through regional alliances, selective diplomacy with Iran, and their own capabilities. When the most valuable targets are civilian infrastructure no one can fully protect, waiting for Washington is no longer the only strategy. Source: @ianbremmer, Foreign Policy / Writer: Lucas

The UK’s @AISecurityInst (AISI) has published a report on their recent cybersecurity evaluation of Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5 and OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol. The models attempted to complete an assignment in a setup where their normal safeguards were removed and they were deliberately given internet access. AISI reports that the models “engaged in sustained, potentially harmful activity directed at real people and organisations”. We’re grateful to AISI for their leadership in the important discussion about how to evaluate increasingly capable AI agents. We’re working closely with them to gather more details of the incident as we conduct our own investigation. Gaining a clear picture of Claude’s understanding of its situation—by examining its reasoning transcripts and running our own analyses—will help us identify the causes of its behavior. The prompts in the evaluation did not impose any specific restrictions on how the internet should be used. This and the removal of safeguards meant that the models were tested under “deliberately permissive conditions” that are not representative of any of our production models. Note that there was no evidence here of an escape from a secure environment. AISI’s disclosure of the incident can be found here: aisi.gov.uk/blog/incident-re…

Good OSINT discipline. Pakistan’s SH-15 is real. The number “250” matches cumulative inductions, not a sudden new border dump. No ISPR confirmation. No independent satellite imagery of mass deployment. Artillery modernization is happening. A dramatic overnight shift of 250 systems remains unverified. Treat the claims as plausible, not proven. Facts over noise. 🇮🇳 Defense News IN (@DefenseNewsIN) Here’s an HVT-style post that keeps the key caveats while remaining engaging and accurate. 🚨 OSINT ASSESSMENT: Pakistan’s SH-15 deployment claims deserve caution. Several Indian media outlets, citing unnamed intelligence sources, reported that Pakistan has deployed 250 SH-15 wheeled 155mm self-propelled howitzers near the border. Here’s what the evidence suggests: • Pakistan already operates the SH-15. The system is real, but reports of “250 units” closely match cumulative procurement and induction figures reported over recent years—not necessarily a brand-new frontline deployment. • No official confirmation has come from Pakistan’s ISPR or Ministry of Defence, and there is no publicly available satellite imagery independently verifying a sudden mass deployment. • The SH-15 is a capable 155mm/52-calibre wheeled artillery system. Typical combat ranges are around 30–40 km, while longer ranges require specialized extended-range ammunition that is not generally considered standard issue. • Claims linking the move directly to Operation Sindoor remain analytical interpretations rather than independently verified facts. Bottom line: Pakistan’s artillery modernization is real. A sudden deployment of 250 newly inducted SH-15s to the border is not yet confirmed by open-source evidence. Conversei na manhã desta terça-feira, 4 de agosto, com o presidente da Federação da Rússia, Vladimir Putin. No telefonema de cerca de uma hora, repassamos os principais temas da agenda bilateral, com destaque para as reuniões que ocorreram este ano, em Brasília, no âmbito da Comissão de Alto Nível (CAN) e da Comissão Intergovernamental de Cooperação Econômica, Comercial, Científica e Tecnológica (CIC). Reforçamos o caráter estratégico das relações Brasil-Rússia e a intenção de intensificar a cooperação em temas como energia, ciência e tecnologia e na área naval. Sublinhei a importância do comércio entre os dois países, com ênfase especial no fornecimento de diesel e fertilizantes. Também ressaltei a necessidade de buscar maior equilíbrio no intercâmbio comercial, com aumento das exportações brasileiras para a Rússia. Discutimos também a situação geopolítica atual. Expressei decepção com a incapacidade do Conselho de Segurança da ONU em encaminhar uma solução para os conflitos e sublinhei a importância do diálogo entre as grandes potências em busca da paz. Nesse contexto, ressaltei os aspectos humanitários dos conflitos e lamentei a perda de vidas humanas, inclusive civis. Expressamos determinação de continuar trabalhando conjuntamente nos foros internacionais, especialmente no BRICS, cujo papel no atual cenário internacional foi enfatizado. Concordamos também quanto ao valor do multilateralismo, baseado em um mundo multipolar. Mencionei a eleição para o cargo de Secretário-Geral das Nações Unidas, reiterando o apoio do Brasil à candidatura de Michelle Bachelet.

Russians have destroyed the 300 year old Holy Nativity Church in Beryslav – the only surviving example in Ukraine of 18th-century wooden Cossack religious architecture. The church was built in 1725 from oak logs, without a single metal nail. It survived wars, empires, and Soviet anti-religious campaigns. In 1784, the Cossacks transported the church across the Dnipro River from Peryvolochne to Beryslav, where it stood for over two centuries. On August 1, a Russian drone completely destroyed the shrine. This is the 337th Ukrainian church destroyed or damaged by Russia since the beginning of the full-scale invasion. The destruction of the church is yet another act of cultural genocide and a deliberate attack on Ukrainian shrines.

"When they tried to cast Atticus Finch for ""To Kill a Mockingbird,"" James Stewart said no—the role was too controversial—but one actor called back immediately and gave a performance that would change American culture forever. Hollywood. Producer Alan J. Pakula had a problem. He'd secured the rights to Harper Lee's Pulitzer Prize-winning novel, a story that was shattering hearts and opening eyes across America. But finding someone to play Atticus Finch—the small-town lawyer who defends a Black man falsely accused of rape in 1930s Alabama—felt impossible. The role demanded something rare: quiet moral authority. Not theatrics. Not bravado. Just the kind of decency that makes you believe goodness can exist even in a broken world. James Stewart passed. Too risky, he thought. Too controversial for the times. Rock Hudson was floated. Pakula wasn't convinced. The role needed more than star power—it needed gravity, wisdom, a man who could make integrity look effortless. Then they called Gregory Peck. ""He called back immediately,"" Pakula later said. ""No maybes."" For Peck, the decision was instant. Something about the story felt achingly familiar. He'd grown up in La Jolla, California—a small town not unlike Harper Lee's fictional Maycomb, Alabama. The characters in her novel felt like people he'd known as a boy. The moral landscape felt like home. ""I put everything I had into it,"" Peck reflected years later. ""All my feelings and everything I'd learned in 46 years of living, about family life and fathers and children. And my feelings about racial justice and inequality and opportunity."" He didn't approach Atticus Finch as a character to perform. He approached him as a person to become. When Harper Lee learned that Gregory Peck would bring her beloved character to life on screen, she was thrilled. But it wasn't until years later—after watching his performance again and again, after seeing how audiences responded—that she understood why it resonated so powerfully. ""The years told me his secret,"" she wrote. ""When he played Atticus Finch, he had played himself, and time has told all of us something more: when he played himself, he touched the world."" The film premiered in 1962. Critics praised it. Audiences wept. In 1963, Gregory Peck won the Academy Award for Best Actor. But the Oscar wasn't what stayed with him. ""Hardly a day passes that I don't think how lucky I was to be cast in that film,"" he said decades later. ""I recently sat at a dinner next to a woman who saw it when she was 14 years old, and she said it changed her life. I hear things like that all the time."" Letters poured in for years. Teachers wrote to say they showed the film to their students every year. Parents wrote to say they named their sons after Atticus. Lawyers wrote to say the film inspired them to pursue justice. Civil rights activists wrote to say it helped people understand. A single performance, reverberating across generations. In 2003, the American Film Institute released its list of the 100 greatest movie heroes of all time. Atticus Finch ranked number one. Not the strongest hero. Not the one who won the most battles or saved the most lives. But the one who stood up for what was right—quietly, calmly, courageously—even when standing completely alone. Because that's what real heroism looks like. Not dramatic speeches or violent confrontation, but steady moral clarity in the face of overwhelming pressure. Gregory Peck gave us that. He showed us what quiet courage looks like. What fatherhood can be. What decency means when the world around you has lost its way. Some performances entertain us for two hours and fade. Others become part of who we are—shaping how we see justice, how we raise our children, how we measure our own character. Gregory Peck didn't just play Atticus Finch. He became the father millions of us wish we'd had—and the person many of us are still trying to be. "

মাত্র ৩৪ বছর বয়সেই মারা গেলেন ইউএফসি’র ব্রাজিলীয় ফ্লাইওয়েট ফাইটার অ্যালান নাসিমেন্তো। নিউইয়র্ক পোস্টের প্রতিবেদনে দাবি করা হয়েছে, সোমবার (৩ আগস্ট) সকালে নিজ বাড়িতে অজ্ঞান অবস্থায় তাকে পাওয়া যায়। প্রথমিকভাবে ধারণা করা হচ্ছে, ঘুমের মধ্যেই হৃদরোগে আক্রান্ত হয়ে তার মৃত্যু হয়েছে। নাসিমেন্তোর মৃত্যুর খবর নিশ্চিত করে এক বিবৃতিতে ইউএফসি জানিয়েছে, ৩ আগস্ট নাসিমেন্তোকে অজ্ঞান অবস্থায় পাওয়া যায়। ঘটনাস্থলে পৌঁছে চিকিৎসাকর্মীরা প্রাণপণ চেষ্টা করলেও তাকে বাঁচানো সম্ভব হয়নি। সংস্থার পক্ষ থেকে তার পরিবার, বন্ধু, সতীর্থ এবং শুভানুধ্যায়ীদের প্রতি গভীর সমবেদনা জানানো হয়েছে। নাসিমেন্তোর সর্বশেষ লড়াই ছিল চলতি বছরের জুনে অনুষ্ঠিত ইউএফসি ফাইট নাইট, কেপ বনাম হরিগুচি ইভেন্টে। সেই ম্যাচে কঠিন প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বিতার পর বিভক্ত সিদ্ধান্তে মিচ রাপোসোর কাছে পরাজিত হন তিনি। নিউইয়র্ক পোস্টের তথ্য অনুযায়ী, ওই লড়াইয়ের মাত্র কয়েক সপ্তাহের মধ্যেই আকস্মিকভাবে মৃত্যুবরণ করেন এই ফাইটার। ২০১৮ সালে দানা হোয়াইট কনটেন্ডার সিরিজে অংশ নিয়ে প্রথমবারের মতো সবার নজরে আসেন নাসিমেন্তো। যদিও সেখানে রাউলিয়ান পাইভার বিপক্ষে বিভক্ত সিদ্ধান্তে হেরে যান, তবুও তার পারফরম্যান্স মুগ্ধ করেছিল ইউএফসি কর্তৃপক্ষকে। পরবর্তীতে বিশ্বের অন্যতম জনপ্রিয় এমএমএ সংস্থা ইউএফসিতে সুযোগ পেয়ে তিনি চারটি জয় তুলে নেন, বিপরীতে হারেন দুটি লড়াইয়ে। এছাড়া দুবার ‘ফাইট অব দ্য নাইট’ সম্মান অর্জন করেন তিনি। #MMA #CombatSports #SportsNews #somoytv

PRESS RELEASE Family Expresses Gratitude To All Who Participated in Buhari’s Burial and Prayers The most senior member of the Buhari family, the family of the late President, Muhammadu Buhari, Malam Mamman Daura has, on behalf of the family expressed gratitude to President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and his wife, the First Lady, Senator Remi Tinubu for their role and that of Government of the Federation before, and after the passing of the former president. “It is truly comforting to receive such support from the President and the Vice President, Kashim Shettima, who went to the United Kingdom, and here in Daura, for the days he and the ministers during the mourning period. These have instilled confidence in all of us to face this loss with courage. “We are deeply grateful to the President on his thoughtful gestures in declaring a public holiday and renaming the University of Maiduguri after Buhari. “Our gratitude also goes to leaders of the various countries around the globe who either came in person, sent representatives, sent letters, or placed personal telephone calls to commiserate with us. Of special note were those of the King of England, King Charles III, the Secretary General of the United Nations, the Deputy Secretary General, Amina Mohammed, the Chairman of the African Union, and that of the Committee of Heads of State and Government of ECOWAS countries, and our former Head of State, Abdulsalami Abubakar. “Muhammadu Buhari’s demise is an irreparable loss and its pain is beyond words, but the general reaction and kind expressions give us the strength to cope with the loss of our esteemed family member and former leader of the country. “The family is equally grateful to Vice President Kashim Shettima in his own person and his wife, and to all state governors, especially those of Katsina, the host governor Dr Dikko Umar Radda; Professor Babagana Umara Zulum of Borno State and all those who visited us in the UK and Daura from Adamawa, Kano, Kwara, Lagos, Kaduna, Imo, Nasarawa, Bauchi, Sokoto, Kebbi as well as the several former governors, including Dr Peter Obi for their compassionate words of condolence. Your empathy has touched our hearts deeply, and we are truly grateful for your kindness. "We express our deep appreciations to former Vice Presidents Atiku Abubakar, Architect Namadi Sambo, Professor Yemi Osinbajo, and Ambassador Babagana Kingibe as well as to the President of Senate, Godswill Akpabio, the Speaker, House of Representatives, Honorable Tajuddeen Abbas, Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin and the other leaders and members of the National and State Assemblies. “We do sincerely thank the Secretary to the Government of the Federation, SGF, Senator George Akume and his predecessor in office, Boss Mustapha, the current Chief of Staff, Honorable Femi Gbajabiamila and his predecessor, Professor Ibrahim Gambari, former and serving members of the cabinet in both administrations for their activities in these events and their comforting words. “We are very pleased with the amazing gestures of our traditional leaders, notably the Sultan of Sokoto, the Shehu of Borno, the Emir of Gwandu and the host emirs of Katsina and Daura, as well as the various emirs and chiefs from all over Nigeria and the neighboring countries who came in person or sent representatives. “We have been honored by the large turnout of religious leaders, Islamic, Christian and of other faiths, community leaders, women, youth and politicians of various leanings whose surge in Daura was both challenging and reassuring. “The family in Daura is also thanking past and serving security and intelligence, police and military leaders, permanent secretaries, and the rank and file civil servants, community groups and associations, civil society, and the media of communications. 1/2

ভয়াবহ দাবানলে পুড়ে ছারখার হওয়া স্পেনের মাদ্রিদের সিয়েরা ওয়েস্তে অঞ্চলের পাশে দাঁড়িয়েছেন আর্জেন্টিনার বিশ্বকাপজয়ী অধিনায়ক লিওনেল মেসি। দুর্যোগে বিধ্বস্ত এলাকাটির পুনর্গঠন কার্যক্রমে সহায়তার জন্য তিনি ৮০ হাজার ইউরো অনুদান দিয়েছেন, যা বাংলাদেশি মুদ্রায় প্রায় ১ কোটি ১৫ লাখ টাকার সমান। মঙ্গলবার (৪ আগস্ট) সামাজিক যোগাযোগমাধ্যমে এক পোস্টে মাদ্রিদ কমিউনিটির প্রেসিডেন্ট ইসাবেল দিয়াস আয়ুসো মেসির এই মানবিক সহায়তার বিষয়টি নিশ্চিত করেন। আয়ুসো জানান, ‘লিও মেসি মাদ্রিদের সিয়েরা ওয়েস্তের পুনর্গঠনের জন্য ৮০ হাজার ইউরো দান করেছেন। আমি তাকে ধন্যবাদ জানাতে চাই এবং বলতে চাই, আমরা মাদ্রিদবাসী তাকে শিগগিরই স্বাগত জানাতে এবং তার প্রাপ্য অভিনন্দন জানাতে মুখিয়ে আছি।’ সাম্প্রতিক সময়ের ভয়াবহ দাবানলে সিয়েরা ওয়েস্তে অঞ্চলের ১৭টি পৌরসভার প্রায় ৩০ হাজার হেক্টর বন ও ভূমি আগুনে পুড়ে ব্যাপক ক্ষতির মুখে পড়ে। এই দুর্যোগের পর ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত মানুষের পাশে দাঁড়াতে বিশেষ অনলাইন অনুদান প্ল্যাটফর্ম চালু করেছে মাদ্রিদ কমিউনিটি। ওই পোর্টালের মাধ্যমে ব্যাংক ট্রান্সফারসহ বিভিন্ন উপায়ে আর্থিক সহায়তা পাঠানোর সুযোগ রাখা হয়েছে, যা পুনর্বাসন ও পুনর্গঠন কার্যক্রমে ব্যয় করা হবে। অনুদান সংগ্রহের উদ্যোগের পাশাপাশি ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত অঞ্চল পুনর্গঠনে ৪৩ দফার একটি বিস্তৃত কর্মপরিকল্পনাও ঘোষণা করেছে স্থানীয় প্রশাসন। এই পরিকল্পনার আওতায় ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত ব্যবসা প্রতিষ্ঠানের জন্য সরাসরি আর্থিক সহায়তা, বিভিন্ন কর-সুবিধা এবং অবকাঠামো পুনর্নির্মাণে প্রায় ২ কোটি ইউরো বরাদ্দের সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়া হয়েছে। তবে সামাজিক ও মানবিক কর্মকাণ্ডে লিওনেল মেসির অংশগ্রহণ নতুন কোনো ঘটনা নয়। তার প্রতিষ্ঠিত ‘লিও মেসি ফাউন্ডেশন’-এর মাধ্যমে বহু বছর ধরে বিশ্বের বিভিন্ন দেশে শিশুদের স্বাস্থ্যসেবা ও শিক্ষার উন্নয়নে নিয়মিত সহায়তা দিয়ে আসছেন আর্জেন্টাইন এই মহাতারকা। এর আগেও দুর্যোগের সময় উদারতার নজির গড়েছেন মেসি। ২০২০ সালে করোনাভাইরাস মহামারির শুরুতে তিনি স্পেনের বার্সেলোনার ক্লিনিক হাসপাতাল এবং নিজের জন্মশহর রোসারিওর একটি চিকিৎসাকেন্দ্রে মোট ১০ লাখ ইউরো অনুদান দেন। #LionelMessi #Football #HumanitarianAid #somoytv

We identified areas for intensifying work with the European Union. Two clusters in the negotiations on Ukraine’s accession to the European Union have already been opened this year, and we are preparing to open four more. Everything has been done on our part to ensure a positive decision. Together with Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi, new Deputy Prime Minister for European and Euro-Atlantic Integration Vsevolod Chentsov, and Deputy Heads of the Office of the President, Sergiy Kyslytsya and Ihor Zhovkva, we agreed on three priorities that must be implemented. First, Ukraine is working specifically toward full membership in the European Union. We view this not only as a political or economic task, but also as a security task – both for us and for the European Union. Ukraine’s accession to the European Union will eliminate the geopolitical uncertainty that Russia has exploited for several decades to sow destabilization in both Ukraine and the European Union. At the same time, with Ukraine’s strength, the European Union gains the necessary security capabilities, making it possible to strengthen the European component of the Euro-Atlantic community. Second, we must take full advantage of all opportunities from Ukraine’s sectoral integration into the European Union right now. Ukraine must be seen by all Europeans as an integral part of normal European processes, and this must drive our political progress and the decisions of leaders and countries. Third, of course, we must build relations at every level in such a way that Ukraine receives the necessary packages and decisions to support resilience this winter. Relations with Brussels and the European institutions, the capitals of Europe, and communities in European countries must be practical – focused on what can genuinely support the protection of life in Ukraine. I expect results. Glory to Ukraine!

A man spent years searching for the nanny who raised him. When he finally found her, he gave her $16,000 and arranged a monthly allowance to ensure she could enjoy the same comfort and care she had once provided him. A French man captured the hearts of millions online after spending 38 years searching for the nanny who cared for him as an infant in Ivory Coast. His father had been stationed there for work, but when the family eventually returned to France, they lost all contact with the woman who had played such an important role in his early life. Despite the decades and distance between them, he never forgot her kindness and maternal affection, considering her a “second mother” and promising himself that he would one day find her and express his gratitude. After finally locating her living a modest life, he traveled back to West Africa for an emotional reunion filled with tears and joy. Wanting to repay the care she had given him, he gifted her 10 million CFA francs (about $16,000 USD), a new car, and arranged a lifelong monthly allowance to support her retirement. The story became a powerful reminder of the lasting impact of compassion and the bonds formed through childhood care.

मेट्रो प्रकल्पांमुळे शहरी सार्वजनिक वाहतूक अधिक सुरक्षित, जलद आणि सक्षम होणार मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज मंत्रालय, मुंबई येथे मंत्रिमंडळ पायाभूत सुविधा समितीची बैठक पार पडली. राज्यातील मेट्रो प्रकल्पांची कामे वेगाने सुरू असून मुंबई, पुणे, नागपूर तसेच मुंबई महानगर प्रदेश ( एमएमआरडीए) मधील शहरी भागांमध्ये सुरक्षित, आधुनिक आणि जलद सार्वजनिक वाहतूक व्यवस्था उभारण्यास मोठी चालना मिळणार असून भविष्यातील नागरी विकासाला गती मिळणार आहे. या दृष्टीने सर्व मेट्रो प्रकल्पांची कामे सुरू झाल्यानंतर तीन वर्षांच्या कालावधीत पूर्ण करण्याच्या दृष्टीने नियोजन करावे, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी दिले. राज्यात ₹2,80,755 कोटींचे मेट्रो प्रकल्प राबविण्यात येत असून, त्यामध्ये केंद्र शासनाचा एकूण हिस्सा ₹27,216 कोटी, तर राज्य शासनाचा थेट हिस्सा ₹50,250 कोटी आहे. याशिवाय एमएमआरडीए, स्थानिक स्वराज्य संस्था व नियोजन प्राधिकरणांच्या माध्यमातून ₹75,729.62 कोटींचे आर्थिक नियोजन करण्यात येणार आहे. उर्वरित निधी शासन हमी कर्जाद्वारे उभारण्यात येणार आहे. काही प्रकल्प पूर्ण झाले असून काही प्रगतिपथावर आहेत, तर काही मंजुरीच्या विविध टप्प्यांत आहेत, अशी माहिती सादरीकरणाद्वारे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांना देण्यात आली. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, महाराष्ट्रात सार्वजनिक वाहतूक अधिक सक्षम, जलद आणि पर्यावरणपूरक करण्यासाठी व्यापक मेट्रो नेटवर्क उभारण्यात येत आहे. सध्या राज्यात 174 कि.मी. मेट्रो मार्ग प्रवाशांसाठी सुरू झाले असून 291 कि.मी. मार्गांवर प्रत्यक्ष बांधकाम सुरू आहे. याशिवाय 130 कि.मी. मार्ग मंजुरीच्या प्रक्रियेत असून 87.15 कि.मी. मार्गांचा सविस्तर प्रकल्प अहवाल (डीपीआर) तयार करण्यात येत आहे. ▪️एकूण 683.53 कि.मी. लांबीचे मेट्रो नेटवर्क मुंबई महानगर प्रदेश (एमएमआर) मध्ये एकूण 428.89 कि.मी., पुणे महानगर प्रदेश (पीएमआर) मध्ये 169.45 कि.मी. आणि नागपूर महानगर प्रदेश (एनएमआर) मध्ये 85.20 कि.मी. मेट्रो नेटवर्क विकसित होत असून राज्यातील प्रस्तावित व कार्यान्वित मेट्रो जाळ्याची एकूण लांबी 683.53 कि.मी. इतकी आहे. राज्य शासनाने वर्षनिहाय नियोजन केले आहे. त्यानुसार मुंबई, पुणे आणि नागपूरमधील विविध मेट्रो मार्गांचा विकास करण्यात येत असून चालू वर्षात 87 कि.मी. मार्ग आणि 56 स्थानके, तर 2029-30 पर्यंत नियोजित 302 कि.मी. मार्ग आणि 161 स्थानकांच्या उभारणीसाठी कार्यवाही करण्यात येत आहे. ▪️मेट्रो-10 मार्गाची उभारणी लवकरच यावेळी बैठकीत एमएमआर प्रदेशातील حزب وحدت اسلامی افغانستان می‌گوید که «با نگرانی عمیق، تصمیم اداره‌ی طالبان مبنی بر کوچ اجباری و اقدامات انجام‌شده برای تخلیه باشندگان شهرک امید سبز را به‌شدت محکوم می‌کند و آن را مغایر با اصول عدالت، حقوق مالکیت، امنیت حقوقی شهروندان و کرامت انسانی می‌داند». این حزب امروز (سه‌شنبه، ۱۳ اسد) با نشر اعلامیه‌ای گفته است: «تصمیم و اقدامات اداره‌ی طالبان در قبال شهرک امید سبز هیچ مبنای حقوقی و مشروعیت اخلاقی ندارد. به‌ویژه آن‌که این اقدام در بستر مجموعه‌ای از سیاست‌ها و رفتارهایی صورت می‌گیرد که نگرانی‌های جدی درباره‌ی تبعیض سیستماتیک علیه هزاره‌ها و شیعیان و تلاش برای تصفیه قومی و تغییر بافت جمعیتی در بخش‌هایی از افغانستان ایجاد کرده است». بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258517

Trump Gives Green Light to Saudi Nuclear Program The Donald Trump administration has finalized the draft of a bilateral nuclear agreement that authorizes Saudi Arabia to enrich uranium on its own territory. Although the negotiating teams have completed the terms, the document still awaits Trump’s final signature and approval by the U.S. Congress. This framework breaks with the region’s long-standing non-proliferation rules. Unlike the deal with the United Arab Emirates, which permanently renounced uranium enrichment and plutonium reprocessing while accepting strict IAEA inspections, the agreement with the Saudis does not require Riyadh to adopt the Agency’s inspection regime. Oversight will be limited to a bilateral pact between the United States and Saudi Arabia. This reinforces what Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has already said openly: if Iran gets a nuclear weapon, Saudi Arabia will want one too. It sounds like a clear signal that Riyadh believes Tehran already has, or is very close to having, the bomb, which explains the intense pressure they are putting on Washington. The situation puts the U.S. in a complicated position. Saudi Arabia’s ballistic missile program is developed in partnership with China, complete with technology transfers. If the Americans don’t give in now, the Saudis have plenty of money to look for other partners. This is not just about civilian nuclear energy. For that, it would be enough to buy reactors and import ready-made fuel. What Riyadh really wants is to master the full nuclear fuel cycle, especially domestic uranium enrichment. With this infrastructure, Saudi Arabia is building a nuclear latency capability: it will control the core technology needed to develop a weapon in relatively short order if pushed by an existential threat. "A German officer found a starving Jewish man hiding in the ruins of Warsaw. Instead of killing him, he asked one question that changed everything. November 1944. Warsaw was a graveyard. The Nazis had crushed the Polish uprising. Buildings lay shattered. Streets were empty except for patrols hunting survivors. Władysław Szpilman had been hiding for months. Before the war, he'd been Poland's most celebrated pianist—playing Chopin on Warsaw Radio while the city danced. Now he was a ghost, surviving on scraps in abandoned buildings. Then the footsteps came. Captain Wilm Hosenfeld of the Wehrmacht discovered Szpilman in an attic. The starving man froze. This was the end. But Hosenfeld didn't raise his weapon. He asked: ""What are you doing here?"" Szpilman told him he'd been a pianist. Hosenfeld's eyes changed. He pointed to a dusty piano in the corner. ""Play something."" So there, in the frozen ruins of a destroyed city, a Jewish man who hadn't touched a piano in years played Chopin's Nocturne in C-sharp minor. His fingers moved from memory. The melody filled the bombed-out room. When the last note faded, Hosenfeld stood in silence. Then he asked where Szpilman was hiding. Not to arrest him. To help him. For weeks, Hosenfeld returned secretly—bringing bread, jam, a warm coat. Helping a Jewish man meant execution if discovered. He came anyway. In December, as German forces prepared to retreat, Hosenfeld visited one last time. He left extra food and his own military blanket. ""Hold on,"" he told Szpilman. ""The Soviets are coming. The war will end soon."" Szpilman gave him his name. ""Remember it. If you ever need help—Szpilman, Polish Radio."" He never saw Hosenfeld again. Szpilman survived. He returned to Warsaw Radio. His first broadcast after liberation? Chopin's Nocturne in C-sharp minor—the same piece he'd played for the officer who saved his life. Hosenfeld didn't survive. Captured by Soviet forces, he was convicted as a war criminal simply for being a German officer. The Soviets ignored testimonies about his humanitarian acts. Szpilman spent years trying to save him. He contacted officials, wrote letters, begged anyone who would listen. It wasn't enough. In 1952, Wilm Hosenfeld died in a Soviet prison camp. He was 57. He never learned that the pianist he'd rescued had tried everything to rescue him in return. Decades later, Szpilman's memoir became the film ""The Pianist,"" winning three Academy Awards. In 2009—57 years after his death—Hosenfeld was finally recognized by Yad Vashem as ""Righteous Among the Nations."" His family accepted the honor he never lived to receive. One question. One piece of music. Two men on opposite sides of history's greatest horror—connected by a moment when humanity won. Szpilman lived to 88. He spent his final years making sure the world remembered the German officer who chose mercy when he could have chosen murder. Because sometimes the most powerful resistance isn't a weapon. It's a piano. "

For four years the story was that a bank closed Trump's accounts because it hated him politically after January 6. Capital One just told a federal judge, in a sworn motion, what actually happened. More than three hundred Trump affiliated accounts were closed in 2021 after months of analysis by the bank's anti money laundering team, flagging transaction patterns that matched federal banking guidance for this kind of review. This is the first time any bank has formally tied money laundering concerns to Trump's business in a court filing. Banks do not make that claim lightly, since it creates its own legal exposure if it is not documented. Capital One says it never accused the Trump Organization of actual illegal laundering, and never publicized any of this at the time because federal banking secrecy law barred it from doing so. A federal judge already tossed two earlier versions of this lawsuit. Capital One is now asking for a permanent dismissal. A nearly identical suit against JPMorgan over Trump's personal accounts is still working through the same argument. Vice-Chairperson of the National Planning Commission, Dr Gunakar Bhatta, and representatives from various ministries and agencies, provided constructive feedback and comments during the meeting.

Prioritising effectiveness in conducting economic diplomacy, the Ministry organised a presentation and interaction programme at the Ministry today, in the presence of Hon. Foreign Minister Mr Shisir Khanal. Brilliant analysis of a bleak situation Danny (Dennis) Citrinowicz ,داني سيترينوفيتش (@citrinowicz) I'm sorry to sound like Cato the Elder, repeating the same warning over and over again, but the reality remains unchanged: no matter what President Trump says or threatens, Tehran shows no indication that it intends to back down. As long as the maritime blockade remains in place and Washington continues to enforce it, Iran is likely to continue targeting commercial shipping transiting the southern channel of the Strait of Hormuz, as well as U.S. military facilities in the Gulf and Jordan. This is not a prediction with certainty; it is the baseline assumption that should guide policy based on the Islamic Republic's behavior and strategic logic. The problem is that threats lose their value when they are not backed by a willingness to act. Every warning that is not enforced weakens American deterrence and raises doubts among U.S. partners about Washington's credibility. If the United States has no intention of following through, it should be far more cautious about issuing ultimatums. If it does intend to act, it must be prepared to accept the costs that come with that decision. The larger problem is the refusal to acknowledge the strategic reality. The administration faces only difficult options. It does not control the Strait of Hormuz, it is not prepared for a large-scale war with Iran, and it is unwilling to accept an Iranian-dominated security order in the Strait. That strategic deadlock has encouraged the search for a "third way," but there is no magic solution to the Iran challenge. Washington ultimately faces two broad choices: adapt its policy to the reality on the ground, or embark on a much broader military confrontation with Iran, one that would likely be costly, prolonged, and offer no guarantee of achieving America's political objectives. Trying to preserve the current status quo is not a sustainable strategy. There is little reason to believe Iran will stop attacking shipping or that the Strait of Hormuz will reopen under the current conditions. The longer Washington avoids making this strategic choice, the greater the damage to American credibility, regional influence, and deterrence. Strategy begins with accepting reality as it is, not as policymakers wish it to be. #iran — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/citrinowicz/status/2084516092236419261#m

Prashant Kishor ended the BJP’s 31-year reign in Bankipur, sealing a stunning bypoll win in the Bihar constituency. #CutTheClutterlooks at the implications of the victory, explains what it says about Bihar & national politics, & why it is unlikely to have an influence on 2026 UP elections. 2. Bihar has been the land of revolutions — from JP’s movement to Lalu Yadav’s social justice revolution. Prashant Kishor’s bypoll victory isn’t quite another revolution yet but it is very significant. Bankipur has been the political fortress of the BJP’s new president Nitin Nabin & his family for 3 decades. Between father and son, they had won the seat 9 consecutive times. 3. Last year, Nitin Nabin won Bankipur by over 52,000 votes. Now, the defeat margin is 20,000 votes, a big turnaround. Why is this loss significant? Bankipur is a very urban, middle-class & upper middle-class seat, where a large number of voters are upper caste. Muslims are not dominant & Yadav numbers aren’t overwhelming. So, the kind of seat that should be a BJP stronghold. 4. Equally important is Prashant Kishor’s own political journey. Just last year, his Jan Suraaj Party managed only 3.34% of Bihar’s vote. But he did not disappear after defeat & this time contested personally — something voters had criticised him for avoiding. His campaign remained consistent. No caste arithmetic. No freebie politics. The implication for now is for Bihar politics, & although state polls are 4 years away, the BJP will be thinking about 2029. Nitish Kumar’s JDU is dead in the water & BJP will worry that by 2029 they might be on their own. Their hope will be that JSP & Congress-RJD will cut each other’s votes. 7. नहीं हैं. मेटा के स्वामित्व वाले वॉट्सऐप ने भारत सहित कई देशों में बड़ी संख्या में अकाउंट्स को 24 घंटे के रिव्यू पर डाल दिया है. इससे यूजर्स न तो किसी को मैसेज भेज पा रहे हैं और न ही अपनी पुरानी चैट्स देख पा रहे हैं. अचानक हुए इस एक्शन से सोशल मीडिया पर हड़कंप मच गया है और लोग अपनी शिकायत दर्ज करा रहे हैं. अगर आपके साथ भी ऐसा हुआ है, तो चिंता करने की बात नहीं है. आइए समझते हैं कि वॉट्सऐप ने ऐसा कदम क्यों उठाया है और आप अपने अकाउंट को वापस चालू करने के लिए कैसे अपील कर सकते हैं. वॉट्सऐप की आधिकारिक सहायता गाइड के अनुसार, जब कोई अकाउंट कंपनी की सेवा शर्तों (Terms of Service) का उल्लंघन करता है, तो उसे रिव्यू में डाल दिया जाता है. अगर आप थर्ड-पार्टी ऐप्स जैसे GB WhatsApp या WhatsApp Plus का उपयोग करते हैं, तो आपका अकाउंट अस्थायी रूप से बैन हो सकता है. इसके अलावा बहुत ज्यादा स्पैम मैसेज भेजना, अनधिकृत डेटा स्क्रैपिंग करना या संदिग्ध गतिविधियों में शामिल होना भी इसका मुख्य कारण हो सकता है. . . जब आपका अकाउंट रिव्यू में होता है, तो वॉट्सऐप की सुरक्षा टीम आपकी अकाउंट गतिविधियों और डिवाइस की जानकारी की जांच करती है. इस दौरान आप ऐप के किसी भी फीचर का इस्तेमाल नहीं कर सकते हैं. आमतौर पर जांच की प्रक्रिया 24 घंटे के भीतर पूरी हो जाती है और फैसला आने के बाद आपको ऐप पर नोटिफिकेशन के जरिए सूचित कर दिया जाता है. अपने अकाउंट को दोबारा चालू कराने के लिए आपको ऐप के अंदर ही विकल्प मिलता है. सबसे पहले वॉट्सऐप ऐप खोलें और स्क्रीन पर दिख रहे 'Send review request' बटन पर टैप करें. इसके बाद अपनी बात लिखें और सबमिट कर दें. ध्यान रखें कि एक बार में केवल एक ही फोन नंबर की समीक्षा की जा सकती है. अगर आपको रिव्यू का ऑप्शन नहीं दिख रहा है, तो इसका मतलब है कि बैन स्थायी है. रिव्यू रिक्वेस्ट भेजने के बाद यूपी सरकार का अनुपूरक बजट 2026-27 पेश, 59 हजार करोड़ से ज्यादा का आकार; बजट में कई लोक-लुभावन योजनाएं अगले साल यानी वर्ष 2027 में होने वाले विधानसभा चुनाव की तैयारियों के बीच योगी सरकार ने प्रदेशवासियों को खुश करने के लिए लोकलुभावन बजट पेश किया है. राम मंदिर चंदा चोरी और दूसरे मुद्दों पर विपक्ष के हंगामे के बीच योगी सरकार के वित्त मंत्री सुरेश खन्ना ने वर्ष 2026-27 के लिए प्रस्तावित अनुपूरक बजट पेश किया. बजट का कुल आकार 59 हजार 19.54 करोड़ रु है, जिसमें राजस्व लेखे का व्यय- 17399.50 करोड़ रु. और पूंजी लेखे का व्यय- 41620.04 करोड़ रु. है. विकास, रोजगार और प्रदेश की अर्थव्यवस्था को मजबूत करने के लिए बजट में सबसे ज्यादा धनराशि भारी और मध्यम उद्योग के लिए प्रस्तावित की गई है. इसके अलावा ग्राम उद्योग और ऊर्जा के क्षेत्र पर भी विशेष ध्यान दिया गया है. प्रदेशवासियों को बेहतर चिकित्सा सुविधाएं उपलब्ध कराने और परिवार कल्याण पर भी विशेष जोर दिया गया है. . . प्रस्तावित अनुपूरक बजट में भारी एवं मध्यम उद्योग के लिए 22,160.88 करोड़ रुपये, ग्राम विकास के लिए 17,942.73 करोड़ रुपये, ऊर्जा के लिए 7,422.27 करोड़ रुपये, चिकित्सा स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण के लिए 2025 करोड़ रुपये, समाज कल्याण के लिए 1655 करोड़ रुपये, महिला कल्याण विभाग के लिए 1094.40 करोड़ रुपये प्रस्तावित किए गये हैं. वर्ष 2026-27 के लिए प्रस्तावित यूपी अनुपूरक बजट पेश किये जाने के दौरान विपक्ष के हंगामे पर सीएम योगी ने विधानसभा को संबोधित किया. उन्होंने विपक्ष के विधायकों को निशाने पर लिया. उन्होंने कहा कि विधानसभा में सभी मुद्दों पर चर्चा हो इसके लिए सभी विधायकों को अवसर दिया गया. सीएम योगी ने कहा कि समाजवादी पार्टी और विपक्ष की यात्रा संवैधानिक नहीं है. सर्वदलीय बैठक में सभी संतों और विधानमंडल दल के सभी नेताओं से बातचीत हुई थी. दिल्ली बैठक में कहा गया था कि नियम के अंतर्गत जो भी प्रस्ताव आएंगे, सरकार उन पर जवाब देगी. उन्होंने कहा कि विपक्ष को चर्चा में विश्वास नहीं है. विपक्ष द्वारा हाउस को लगातार डिस्टर्ब किया गया. उत्तर प्रदेश की 25 करोड़ जनता के साथ खिलवाड़ किया जा रहा है. वहीं अनुपूरक बजट पेश किये जाने के दौरान और सीएम योगी के संबोधन पर विपक्ष के विधायकों द्वारा हंगामे पर विधानसभा अध्यक्ष सतीश महाना लगातार विधायकों को डांटते नजर आए. सतीश महाना ने हंगामा कर रहे विपक्ष के विधायकों को सदन से बाहर जाने के लिए कहा. #UttarPradesh #UPBudget #UPBudget2026 #UPNews #YogiAdityanath

India, as Chair of BRICS 2026, is set to host the 3rd BRICS Culture Working Group Meeting in Bhopal, the City of Lakes, on 5–6 August 2026. Dr. Joram Aniya, Member, NITI Aayog, and Dr. R. Balasubramaniam, Member, NITI Aayog, visited H.D. Kote and Saragur taluks in Mysuru district, Karnataka, where they interacted with tribal communities, students, teachers, women entrepreneurs, and grassroots institutions to review initiatives focused on education, livelihoods, innovation, and community-led development. The Members visited the Ekalavya Model Residential School (EMRS), Sollepura, the Government Ashrama School at Metikuppe, and the Tribal Girls Hostel at Kenchanahalli, where they interacted with students and teachers and reviewed efforts to strengthen educational opportunities for tribal communities. They also visited the Viveka Tribal Centre for Learning, Hosahalli, to gain insights into community-driven approaches to education and development. During the visit, Dr. Joram Aniya inaugurated the JAN AI Café at the Prakruthi Millet Canteen and interacted with members of tribal women enterprises, highlighting the role of technology and innovation in strengthening grassroots entrepreneurship and sustainable livelihoods. The delegation also visited the SVYM Saragur Campus, including the Vivekananda Memorial Hospital, Viveka School of Excellence, Janadhwani Community Radio Station, the SVYM Palliative Care Centre, and the Vivekananda Institute for Leadership Development, where they reviewed initiatives spanning healthcare, education, leadership development, and community outreach. The visit reaffirmed the importance of quality education, healthcare, innovation, women's empowerment, and community participation in enabling the holistic development of tribal and underserved communities. #TribalDevelopment #InclusiveDevelopment @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp @drrbalu

Noor Jalali, the Islamic Emirate's Minister of Public Health, said at the launch ceremony of the National Five-Year Health Strategy that the strategy has been developed based on transparency, sound principles, and the core priorities of the country's healthcare system, and encompasses broad responsibilities. He described support for domestic production as one of the strategy's main pillars, adding that its implementation will promote locally produced health-related products and help reduce dependence on neighboring countries. According to Jalali, improving healthcare services and strengthening the capacity of the health sector are also among the key priorities of the five-year strategy. #TOLOnews_English
